rules.rule_name: New Session Redirect to Sign-On
rules.rule_description: When the Bill Payment program is invoked without an active session, the user must be redirected to the Sign-On screen before any bill payment activity can occur.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
1:Session Initialization
Redirect to Sign-On Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user attempts to access the Bill Payment screen
acceptance_criteria.When: No active session exists (communication area length is zero)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the destination program to 'COSGN00C' (Sign-On screen) and transfers control to it, preventing access to the Bill Payment screen

rules.rule_name: First Entry Screen Initialization
rules.rule_description: On the first visit to the Bill Payment screen within an active session, the screen is initialized with cleared fields and the cursor is placed on the Account ID field. If an account was pre-selected from a prior screen, the Account ID is pre-populated and account lookup is triggered automatically.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
2:Screen Entry Setup
Initialize display fields
Pre-populate Account ID if passed

acceptance_criteria.Given: An active session exists and the user is visiting the Bill Payment screen for the first time
acceptance_criteria.When: The program detects it has not been re-entered before (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER is not set)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the screen as re-entered for future visits, clears all display fields to low-values, sets the cursor to the Account ID field, and if a pre-selected transaction value (CDEMO-CB00-TRN-SELECTED) is present (not spaces or low-values), pre-populates the Account ID field with that value and automatically processes it as an Enter key action before displaying the Bill Payment screen

rules.rule_name: User Input Reception on Return Visit
rules.rule_description: On a return visit to the Bill Payment screen, the system receives the user's input data including the Account ID and the payment confirmation indicator from the screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
3:User Input Reception
Receive bill payment screen data
Account ID and confirmation indicator

acceptance_criteria.Given: An active session exists and the user has previously visited the Bill Payment screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The user submits the Bill Payment screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system receives the screen input data (Account ID field ACTIDINI and Confirmation field CONFIRMI from map COBIL0A/COBIL00) into the input map area for further processing

rules.rule_name: PF3 Key - Return to Previous Screen
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF3, the system navigates back to the screen from which the user originally came. If no originating screen is recorded, the user is sent to the main menu.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
4:Navigation Key Handling - PF3
Return to previous screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen with an active session
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the PF3 function key
acceptance_criteria.Then: If an originating program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM) is recorded and is not spaces or low-values, the system sets the destination to that originating program; otherwise the destination is set to 'COMEN01C' (main menu), and control is transferred to the destination program passing the current communication area

rules.rule_name: PF4 Key - Clear Current Screen
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF4, all input and display fields on the Bill Payment screen are cleared, allowing the user to start a new payment entry.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
4:Navigation Key Handling - PF4
Clear current screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen with an active session
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the PF4 function key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system clears all input fields (Account ID, Current Balance display, Confirmation indicator) and the message area, then redisplays the blank Bill Payment screen

rules.rule_name: Invalid Function Key Handling
rules.rule_description: Any function key other than ENTER, PF3, or PF4 is not supported on the Bill Payment screen and results in an error message being displayed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
4:Navigation Key Handling - Invalid Key
Display error message

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen with an active session
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses any key other than ENTER, PF3, or PF4
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the standard invalid key message (CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY) on the screen, and redisplays the Bill Payment screen without processing any input

rules.rule_name: Account ID Mandatory Validation
rules.rule_description: The Account ID is a required field on the Bill Payment screen. The payment process cannot proceed without a valid Account ID being entered.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
5:Account ID Validation Error
Display - Please enter an Account ID

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen and presses the ENTER key
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID field (ACTIDINI) is blank or contains only low-values
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the message 'Acct ID can NOT be empty...', sets the cursor position to the Account ID field (ACTIDINL = -1), and redisplays the Bill Payment screen without performing any account lookup or payment processing

rules.rule_name: Payment Confirmation - Confirmed with Y
rules.rule_description: When the user enters 'Y' or 'y' in the Confirmation field, the system sets the payment confirmation flag and proceeds to look up the account details to process the payment.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
6:Payment Confirmation - Y/y
Proceed with payment confirmation

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid Account ID on the Bill Payment screen and presses ENTER
acceptance_criteria.When: The Confirmation field (CONFIRMI) contains 'Y' or 'y'
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the payment confirmation flag (CONF-PAY-YES) to TRUE and performs an account data lookup (READ-ACCTDAT-FILE) using the entered Account ID to retrieve the account record for payment processing

rules.rule_name: Payment Confirmation - Cancelled with N
rules.rule_description: When the user enters 'N' or 'n' in the Confirmation field, the payment request is cancelled and the screen is cleared.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
6:Payment Confirmation - N/n
Cancel and clear screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid Account ID on the Bill Payment screen and presses ENTER
acceptance_criteria.When: The Confirmation field (CONFIRMI) contains 'N' or 'n'
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system clears all input fields (Account ID, Current Balance display, Confirmation indicator) and the message area, sets the error flag to 'Y', and redisplays the blank Bill Payment screen without performing any payment processing

rules.rule_name: Payment Confirmation - Blank Triggers Account Lookup Only
rules.rule_description: When the Confirmation field is left blank, the system performs an account lookup to display the current balance and prompts the user to confirm the payment, implementing the two-step payment process.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
6:Payment Confirmation - Blank
Look up account without confirming

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid Account ID on the Bill Payment screen and presses ENTER
acceptance_criteria.When: The Confirmation field (CONFIRMI) is blank or contains low-values
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system performs an account data lookup (READ-ACCTDAT-FILE) using the entered Account ID to retrieve and display the current balance, without setting the payment confirmation flag, so the user is subsequently prompted to confirm the payment

rules.rule_name: Payment Confirmation - Invalid Value Validation
rules.rule_description: The Confirmation field only accepts 'Y', 'y', 'N', 'n', or blank. Any other value is rejected with a validation error.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
6:Payment Confirmation - Invalid
Display error - Valid values are Y/N

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid Account ID on the Bill Payment screen and presses ENTER
acceptance_criteria.When: The Confirmation field (CONFIRMI) contains any value other than 'Y', 'y', 'N', 'n', blank, or low-values
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the message 'Invalid value. Valid values are (Y/N)...', sets the cursor to the Confirmation field (CONFIRML = -1), and redisplays the Bill Payment screen without performing any account lookup or payment processing

rules.rule_name: Account Balance Lookup from Account Data File
rules.rule_description: The system retrieves the account record from the Account Data file using the entered Account ID to obtain the current outstanding balance for display and payment processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
7:Account Balance Lookup
Retrieve account details using Account ID

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid Account ID and the Confirmation field is either 'Y', 'y', or blank
acceptance_criteria.When: The system performs an account lookup using the Account ID (ACCT-ID) as the key against the Account Data file (ACCTDAT) with an update intent
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the account is found, the account record including the current balance (ACCT-CURR-BAL) is retrieved and the current balance is displayed on the screen (CURBALI of COBIL0AI); if the account is not found, the error message 'Account ID NOT found...' is displayed with the cursor on the Account ID field; if any other error occurs, the message 'Unable to lookup Account...' is displayed with the cursor on the Account ID field

rules.rule_name: Zero or Negative Balance Payment Prevention
rules.rule_description: A bill payment cannot be initiated if the account has no outstanding balance. Accounts with a zero or negative current balance are blocked from making payments.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
8:Zero Balance Check
Display - You have nothing to pay

acceptance_criteria.Given: The account has been successfully retrieved from the Account Data file
acceptance_criteria.When: The account's current balance (ACCT-CURR-BAL) is less than or equal to zero AND the Account ID field is not blank or low-values
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the message 'You have nothing to pay...', sets the cursor to the Account ID field (ACTIDINL = -1), and redisplays the Bill Payment screen without proceeding to payment confirmation or processing

rules.rule_name: Current Balance Display on Screen
rules.rule_description: After a successful account lookup, the account's current outstanding balance is displayed on the Bill Payment screen so the user can review the amount before confirming payment.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
9:Display Current Balance
Show current balance on screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The account has been successfully retrieved from the Account Data file and no errors have occurred
acceptance_criteria.When: The account record is read successfully with a positive current balance
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system moves the account current balance (ACCT-CURR-BAL) to the working storage balance field (WS-CURR-BAL) and populates the current balance display field (CURBALI of COBIL0AI) on the Bill Payment screen

rules.rule_name: Prompt User to Confirm Payment
rules.rule_description: When the account has been looked up successfully but the user has not yet confirmed the payment, the system prompts the user to confirm before processing the payment, implementing a two-step payment safety mechanism.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
10:Prompt for Payment Confirmation
Display - Confirm to make a bill payment

acceptance_criteria.Given: The account has been successfully retrieved, the current balance is greater than zero, and no errors have occurred
acceptance_criteria.When: The payment confirmation flag (CONF-PAY-YES) is not set to TRUE (user has not entered 'Y' or 'y' in the Confirmation field)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays the message 'Confirm to make a bill payment...' and sets the cursor to the Confirmation field (CONFIRML = -1), then redisplays the Bill Payment screen awaiting the user's Y or N response

rules.rule_name: Card Cross-Reference Lookup by Account ID
rules.rule_description: Before processing a confirmed bill payment, the system retrieves the card number associated with the account from the Card Cross-Reference file, which is required to record on the payment transaction.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
11:Card Cross-Reference Lookup
Retrieve card number for Account ID

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has confirmed the payment with 'Y' or 'y', the account exists, and the current balance is greater than zero
acceptance_criteria.When: The system performs a lookup on the Card Cross-Reference file (CXACAIX) using the Account ID (XREF-ACCT-ID) as the key
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the card cross-reference record is found, the associated card number (XREF-CARD-NUM) is retrieved for use in the transaction record; if the account ID is not found in the cross-reference, the error message 'Account ID NOT found...' is displayed with the cursor on the Account ID field; if any other error occurs, the message 'Unable to lookup XREF AIX file...' is displayed with the cursor on the Account ID field

rules.rule_name: Sequential Transaction ID Generation
rules.rule_description: Each bill payment transaction requires a unique Transaction ID. The system generates the next sequential ID by finding the most recently created transaction and incrementing its ID by one.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
12:New Transaction ID Generation
Browse transaction file from highest ID
Increment last ID by 1

acceptance_criteria.Given: The card cross-reference has been successfully retrieved and payment processing is proceeding
acceptance_criteria.When: The system needs to assign a new Transaction ID for the bill payment
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets TRAN-ID to HIGH-VALUES, starts a browse of the Transaction file (TRANSACT) from the highest possible Transaction ID, reads the previous (last/highest existing) transaction record to obtain its ID (if no transactions exist, TRAN-ID is set to zeros), ends the browse, moves the retrieved TRAN-ID to numeric working storage (WS-TRAN-ID-NUM), and adds 1 to generate the new unique Transaction ID

rules.rule_name: Bill Payment Transaction Record Creation
rules.rule_description: A complete transaction record is built for the bill payment with all required business attributes including type, category, source, description, full payment amount, card number, merchant details, and timestamps.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
13:Bill Payment Transaction Record Creation
Build transaction record:
Type=02, Category=2, Source=POS TERM
Desc=BILL PAYMENT - ONLINE
Amount=Full Balance, Merchant=BILL PAYMENT
Timestamp=Current Date/Time

acceptance_criteria.Given: A new Transaction ID has been generated and payment processing is proceeding
acceptance_criteria.When: The system builds the bill payment transaction record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system initializes a blank transaction record and populates it with: Transaction ID = newly generated sequential ID, Transaction Type Code = '02', Transaction Category Code = 2, Transaction Source = 'POS TERM', Transaction Description = 'BILL PAYMENT - ONLINE', Transaction Amount = the full current account balance (ACCT-CURR-BAL), Card Number = the card number retrieved from the cross-reference (XREF-CARD-NUM), Merchant ID = 999999999, Merchant Name = 'BILL PAYMENT', Merchant City = 'N/A', Merchant Zip = 'N/A', and both the origination timestamp (TRAN-ORIG-TS) and processing timestamp (TRAN-PROC-TS) are set to the current system date and time

rules.rule_name: Transaction Record Write to Transaction File
rules.rule_description: The completed bill payment transaction record is written to the Transaction file to permanently record the payment.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
14:Transaction Record Write
Write new transaction to transaction file

acceptance_criteria.Given: The bill payment transaction record has been fully built with all required fields
acceptance_criteria.When: The system writes the transaction record to the Transaction file (TRANSACT) using the Transaction ID (TRAN-ID) as the record key
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the write is successful, the system proceeds to update the account balance; if a duplicate Transaction ID is detected, the error message 'Tran ID already exist...' is displayed with the cursor on the Account ID field and no account update occurs; if any other error occurs, the message 'Unable to Add Bill pay Transaction...' is displayed with the cursor on the Account ID field and no account update occurs

rules.rule_name: Account Balance Reduction After Payment
rules.rule_description: After a successful transaction write, the account's current balance is reduced by the full payment amount (resulting in a zero balance) and the account record is updated in the Account Data file.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
15:Account Balance Update
Subtract payment amount from balance
Update account record to zero balance

acceptance_criteria.Given: The bill payment transaction record has been successfully written to the Transaction file
acceptance_criteria.When: The system updates the account balance
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system computes the new account balance as: ACCT-CURR-BAL = ACCT-CURR-BAL minus TRAN-AMT (which equals the full prior balance, resulting in zero), then rewrites the updated account record to the Account Data file (ACCTDAT); if the account is not found during update, the message 'Account ID NOT found...' is displayed; if any other error occurs, the message 'Unable to Update Account...' is displayed

rules.rule_name: Payment Success Notification with Transaction ID
rules.rule_description: Upon successful completion of the bill payment, the user is notified with a green success message that includes the assigned Transaction ID as a payment reference, and all input fields are cleared.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
16:Payment Success Notification
Display success message in green
Show assigned Transaction ID
Clear all input fields

acceptance_criteria.Given: The bill payment transaction has been successfully written and the account balance has been updated to zero
acceptance_criteria.When: The transaction write operation completes with a normal response
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system clears all input fields (Account ID, Current Balance display, Confirmation indicator, and message area), sets the message color to green (DFHGREEN for ERRMSGC of COBIL0AO), and displays the success message constructed as: 'Payment successful.  Your Transaction ID is [TRAN-ID].' where TRAN-ID is the assigned transaction identifier, then redisplays the Bill Payment screen

rules.rule_name: Screen Clear and Field Reset
rules.rule_description: All input and display fields on the Bill Payment screen are reset to their initial empty state, used when the user presses PF4 or cancels with 'N'.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
17:Screen Clear / Reset
Clear all input and display fields

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF4 or enters 'N'/'n' in the Confirmation field
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the cursor position indicator for Account ID (ACTIDINL of COBIL0AI) to -1, clears the Account ID input field (ACTIDINI of COBIL0AI) to spaces, clears the Current Balance display field (CURBALI of COBIL0AI) to spaces, clears the Confirmation input field (CONFIRMI of COBIL0AI) to spaces, and clears the working storage message field (WS-MESSAGE) to spaces, then redisplays the Bill Payment screen

rules.rule_name: Bill Payment Screen Display with Header
rules.rule_description: Every time the Bill Payment screen is rendered, the header information is refreshed with current application titles, program name, transaction name, and the current date and time before the screen is sent to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
18:Bill Payment Screen Display
Populate header: App Title, Program Name
Transaction ID, Current Date, Current Time
Render screen with messages/data

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system needs to display the Bill Payment screen to the user
acceptance_criteria.When: The send screen operation is triggered for any reason (initial display, error, confirmation prompt, or success)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system populates the screen header with: application title line 1 (CCDA-TITLE01 to TITLE01O), application title line 2 (CCDA-TITLE02 to TITLE02O), current transaction name (WS-TRANID to TRNNAMEO), current program name (WS-PGMNAME to PGMNAMEO), current date formatted as MM-DD-YY (to CURDATEO), and current time formatted as HH-MM-SS (to CURTIMEO), then moves the working storage message (WS-MESSAGE) to the screen error message field (ERRMSGO of COBIL0AO) and sends the map COBIL0A from mapset COBIL00 with ERASE and CURSOR options

rules.rule_name: Return Control to Calling Program or Main Menu
rules.rule_description: When navigating away from the Bill Payment screen, control is transferred to the appropriate destination program with the updated communication area containing session context.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
19:Return to Previous Screen
Transfer control to calling program
or main menu with updated context

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has triggered a navigation action (PF3 or new session redirect)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the return-to-previous-screen logic
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the destination program (CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) is low-values or spaces, it is defaulted to 'COSGN00C'; the system then sets CDEMO-FROM-TRANID to the current transaction ID (WS-TRANID), sets CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM to the current program name (WS-PGMNAME), sets CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT to zeros, and transfers control via XCTL to the destination program passing the updated CARDDEMO-COMMAREA

rules.rule_name: Detect Missing User Session on Bill Payment Access
rules.rule_description: When a user attempts to access the Bill Payment function, the system must verify that an active user session exists. If no session data is present, the user must be redirected to the Sign-On screen before any bill payment activity is permitted.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Does an active user session exist?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user attempts to access the Bill Payment function
acceptance_criteria.When: No active user session exists (no communication area data is passed to the program)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system determines that the user is not authenticated and must not be allowed to proceed to the Bill Payment screen; the Sign-On screen is identified as the required destination

rules.rule_name: Identify Sign-On Screen as Destination for Unauthenticated Access
rules.rule_description: When no active session is detected, the system must designate the Sign-On screen (COSGN00C) as the target destination so that the user can authenticate before accessing the Bill Payment function.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Identify Sign-On Screen as the destination

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has determined that no active user session exists
acceptance_criteria.When: The destination screen needs to be set for the unauthenticated user
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the destination program to the Sign-On screen identified as 'COSGN00C'

rules.rule_name: Record Current Program and Transaction Details for Return Navigation
rules.rule_description: Before redirecting an unauthenticated user to the Sign-On screen, the system must record the current Bill Payment program name and transaction identifier so that navigation context is preserved for potential return routing after sign-on.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Record current program and transaction details for return navigation

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is about to redirect the user to the Sign-On screen due to no active session
acceptance_criteria.When: The return navigation details are being prepared
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system records the current transaction identifier (WS-TRANID) as the originating transaction, records the current program name (WS-PGMNAME) as the originating program, and resets the program context indicator to zero to indicate a fresh navigation state

rules.rule_name: Redirect Unauthenticated User to Sign-On Screen
rules.rule_description: After recording navigation details, the system must transfer control to the Sign-On screen, passing the session communication area, so the user can authenticate. This enforces that only authenticated users can access the Bill Payment function.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Redirect User to Sign-On Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: No active user session exists and the Sign-On screen has been identified as the destination, and current program and transaction details have been recorded
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the redirect
acceptance_criteria.Then: Control is transferred to the Sign-On screen program ('COSGN00C') along with the current communication area data, and the Bill Payment program terminates its current execution

rules.rule_name: Load Existing Session Data for Authenticated User
rules.rule_description: When an active user session is detected, the system must load the existing session data from the communication area into the working session context so that user identity, navigation history, and prior screen state are available for the Bill Payment function.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Proceed to Bill Payment Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user attempts to access the Bill Payment function
acceptance_criteria.When: An active user session exists (communication area data is present and its length is greater than zero)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system loads the full session communication area data into the active working session context (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) and proceeds to display the Bill Payment screen

rules.rule_name: Detect First Entry and Initialize Bill Payment Screen Display
rules.rule_description: On the very first entry into the Bill Payment screen, the system must initialize all screen output fields to ensure no stale or residual data is shown to the user before any account information is loaded.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Initialize all display fields
Clear screen output area

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user navigates to the Bill Payment screen for the first time within the current session, meaning the program re-entry flag (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER) has not yet been set
acceptance_criteria.When: The program detects that this is the initial entry by evaluating that CDEMO-PGM-REENTER is NOT set to TRUE
acceptance_criteria.Then: All screen output display fields (COBIL0AO) are cleared by setting them to LOW-VALUES, ensuring no residual data from a previous session or screen is visible to the user

rules.rule_name: Mark Bill Payment Session as Re-Entry to Prevent Re-Initialization
rules.rule_description: After the first entry is detected and initialization begins, the session must be flagged as re-entering so that subsequent interactions with the same screen do not trigger re-initialization of the display fields.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Initialize all display fields
Clear screen output area

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has confirmed this is the first entry into the Bill Payment screen (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER is NOT TRUE)
acceptance_criteria.When: The first-entry initialization process begins
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program re-entry flag (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER) is set to TRUE so that all future interactions with this screen within the same session are treated as return visits and do not re-initialize the screen

rules.rule_name: Position Cursor on Account ID Field at Screen Entry
rules.rule_description: When the Bill Payment screen is first displayed, the cursor must be automatically positioned on the Account ID input field to guide the user to enter the required account information without manual navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Initialize all display fields
Clear screen output area

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Bill Payment screen is being initialized for first-time display
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen initialization process sets up the input fields
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor length indicator for the Account ID field (ACTIDINL of COBIL0AI) is set to -1, which positions the cursor on the Account ID input field when the screen is rendered

rules.rule_name: Detect Whether an Account ID Was Passed from a Previous Screen
rules.rule_description: During first entry setup, the system must determine whether a prior screen has already provided an Account ID for bill payment processing. This allows seamless navigation where account context is carried forward automatically.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Was an Account ID
passed from a
previous screen?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Bill Payment screen is being initialized for the first time
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the pre-selected transaction value (CDEMO-CB00-TRN-SELECTED) passed through the communication area from the previous screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: If CDEMO-CB00-TRN-SELECTED contains a value that is neither SPACES nor LOW-VALUES, the system determines that an Account ID has been passed from the previous screen and proceeds to pre-populate it; otherwise, the screen is displayed with an empty Account ID field awaiting manual user input

rules.rule_name: Pre-Populate Account ID Field with Value Passed from Previous Screen
rules.rule_description: When an Account ID has been passed from a previous screen, the Bill Payment screen must automatically populate the Account ID input field with that value, eliminating the need for the user to re-enter information already known to the system.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Pre-populate Account ID field
with value passed from
previous screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Bill Payment screen is being initialized for the first time AND the pre-selected transaction value (CDEMO-CB00-TRN-SELECTED) from the previous screen is not empty (not SPACES and not LOW-VALUES)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system detects a valid Account ID has been passed from the previous screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account ID input field on the Bill Payment screen (ACTIDINI of COBIL0AI) is populated with the value from CDEMO-CB00-TRN-SELECTED, so the user sees the account already filled in

rules.rule_name: Automatically Process Pre-Populated Account ID to Retrieve Account Details
rules.rule_description: When an Account ID is pre-populated from a previous screen, the system must automatically trigger the account lookup and validation process — as if the user had manually entered the Account ID and pressed Enter — so that the current balance is retrieved and displayed without requiring an additional user action.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Process the pre-populated
Account ID to retrieve
account details

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Bill Payment screen is being initialized for the first time AND the Account ID field has been pre-populated with a value passed from the previous screen (CDEMO-CB00-TRN-SELECTED is not SPACES and not LOW-VALUES)
acceptance_criteria.When: The pre-population of the Account ID field is complete
acceptance_criteria.Then: The PROCESS-ENTER-KEY routine is invoked automatically to validate the Account ID, look up the account record, retrieve the current balance, and apply all associated business validations (empty account ID check, balance check, confirmation field evaluation) as if the user had pressed the Enter key

rules.rule_name: Display Bill Payment Screen with Initialized or Pre-Populated Data
rules.rule_description: After all first-entry initialization steps are complete — whether or not an Account ID was pre-populated — the Bill Payment screen must be sent to the user with the current header information (date, time, program name, transaction name) and any data that has been set up during initialization.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Display Bill Payment Screen
with initialized or
pre-populated data

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Bill Payment screen has completed its first-entry initialization, including clearing display fields, optionally pre-populating the Account ID, and optionally processing the pre-populated account
acceptance_criteria.When: All initialization steps have been executed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN routine is invoked, which: (1) populates the screen header with the current date (MM-DD-YY format), current time (HH:MM:SS format), transaction name, and program name; (2) moves any pending message to the error message field (ERRMSGO of COBIL0AO); and (3) sends the COBIL0A map from the COBIL00 mapset to the user's terminal with ERASE and CURSOR options, making the screen ready for user input

key_functionalities.title: User Input Reception
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([User Submits Bill Payment Screen])
    B[Capture All Screen Input Data\nfrom Bill Payment Screen]

rules.rule_name: Capture Bill Payment Screen Input Data
rules.rule_description: When a user submits the Bill Payment screen on a return visit, the system must receive and capture all data entered by the user from the Bill Payment screen map (COBIL0A) into the input data structure for subsequent processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Capture All Screen Input Data
from Bill Payment Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has previously visited the Bill Payment screen (the session is marked as re-entering) and has submitted the screen with input data
acceptance_criteria.When: The system receives the submitted Bill Payment screen data from map 'COBIL0A' within mapset 'COBIL00' into the Bill Payment input data area (COBIL0AI)
acceptance_criteria.Then: All user-entered data from the Bill Payment screen is captured into the input data structure (COBIL0AI), making it available for downstream processing including key press evaluation and business validations

rules.rule_name: Capture Account ID Input Field
rules.rule_description: The Account ID entered by the user on the Bill Payment screen is captured as part of the screen receive operation. This value (ACTIDINI) represents the account for which the user wishes to make a bill payment and is the primary identifier used in all subsequent account lookup and payment processing steps.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Account ID Field Captured
ACTIDINI

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a value (or left blank) in the Account ID field on the Bill Payment screen and submitted the screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system captures the Bill Payment screen input data
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account ID value entered by the user is stored in the Account ID input field (ACTIDINI of COBIL0AI) and is available for validation and account lookup processing

rules.rule_name: Capture Payment Confirmation Indicator Input Field
rules.rule_description: The Payment Confirmation Indicator entered by the user on the Bill Payment screen is captured as part of the screen receive operation. This value (CONFIRMI) represents the user's intent to confirm or cancel the bill payment and drives the two-step payment confirmation workflow.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Payment Confirmation Indicator Captured
CONFIRMI

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a value (Y, N, or left blank) in the Payment Confirmation field on the Bill Payment screen and submitted the screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system captures the Bill Payment screen input data
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Payment Confirmation Indicator value entered by the user is stored in the Confirmation input field (CONFIRMI of COBIL0AI) and is available for payment confirmation decision processing

rules.rule_name: Screen Input Reception Restricted to Return Visits Only
rules.rule_description: The system only attempts to receive and capture user input from the Bill Payment screen when the user is returning to the screen (re-entry mode). On the very first visit to the screen, no input reception occurs — the screen is simply displayed to the user. This ensures that input capture only happens when there is actual user-submitted data to process.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: User Submits Bill Payment Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has an active session and is interacting with the Bill Payment screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The program determines whether this is the user's first visit or a return visit to the Bill Payment screen by checking the re-entry flag (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If it is a return visit (re-entry flag is TRUE), the system proceeds to receive and capture screen input data; if it is the first visit (re-entry flag is FALSE), the system skips input reception, marks the session as re-entering for future visits, and directly displays the Bill Payment screen

rules.rule_name: PF3 Navigation - Return to Previous Screen When Prior Screen Exists
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF3 on the Bill Payment screen and a prior originating screen is recorded in the session, the system navigates the user back to that originating screen, passing along the current session context.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Navigate Back to Previous Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen and a prior originating program name is recorded in the session communication area (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is not blank and not empty)
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the PF3 (Go Back) function key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the destination program to the recorded originating program name (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM), records the current program name and transaction ID as the 'from' context, resets the program context to zero, and transfers control to the originating screen

rules.rule_name: PF3 Navigation - Return to Main Menu When No Prior Screen Exists
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF3 on the Bill Payment screen and no prior originating screen is recorded in the session, the system redirects the user to the main menu screen (COMEN01C) as the default fallback destination.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Navigate to Main Menu COMEN01C

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen and no prior originating program is recorded in the session communication area (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is blank or empty)
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the PF3 (Go Back) function key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the destination program to the main menu program 'COMEN01C', records the current program name and transaction ID as the 'from' context, resets the program context to zero, and transfers control to the main menu screen

rules.rule_name: PF4 Navigation - Clear All Bill Payment Screen Fields
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF4 on the Bill Payment screen, all input and display fields are cleared and the screen is redisplayed in a blank state, allowing the user to start a new bill payment entry.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Clear All Screen Fields Account ID, Balance, Confirmation, Messages

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen with any data entered or displayed in the Account ID, Current Balance, Confirmation, or Message fields
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the PF4 (Clear Screen) function key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system clears the Account ID field to spaces, clears the Current Balance field to spaces, clears the Confirmation field to spaces, clears the message area to spaces, sets the cursor position to the Account ID field, and redisplays the Bill Payment screen in a blank state

rules.rule_name: Invalid Function Key - Display Error Message
rules.rule_description: When the user presses any function key other than ENTER, PF3, or PF4 on the Bill Payment screen, the system rejects the action and displays a standard invalid key error message, keeping the user on the same screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Error Message Invalid Key Pressed

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses any key that is not ENTER, PF3, or PF4
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', populates the message area with the standard invalid key message (CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY), and redisplays the Bill Payment screen with the error message shown, without processing any data

rules.rule_name: PF3 Navigation - Transfer Session Context to Destination Screen
rules.rule_description: When navigating away from the Bill Payment screen via PF3, the system ensures the session communication area carries the correct originating program identity and transaction ID so the destination screen knows where the user came from.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Navigate Back to Previous Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF3 and a destination program has been determined (either the prior originating screen or the main menu COMEN01C)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the return-to-previous-screen navigation
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system records the current Bill Payment transaction ID into the session 'from transaction ID' field (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID), records the current Bill Payment program name into the session 'from program' field (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM), resets the program context indicator to zero (CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT), and transfers control to the destination program passing the full session communication area

key_functionalities.title: Account ID Validation

rules.rule_name: Account ID Mandatory Field Validation
rules.rule_description: The Bill Payment process requires a valid Account ID before any processing can occur. The system must validate that the Account ID field contains a value when the user submits the Bill Payment screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Account ID blank or empty?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen and has pressed the ENTER key to submit the form
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID field is blank or contains only empty/null values
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must reject the submission, set the error indicator to active, display the error message 'Acct ID can NOT be empty...', position the cursor on the Account ID field, and redisplay the Bill Payment screen with the error message — preventing any further processing steps from executing

rules.rule_name: Account ID Presence Check Allows Proceeding
rules.rule_description: When the Account ID field contains a value, the Bill Payment process is permitted to advance to the next validation step without triggering any error condition.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: No - Account ID has a value

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen and has pressed the ENTER key to submit the form
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID field contains a non-blank, non-empty value
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must not set any error flag or display any error message related to Account ID, and must proceed to the next validation step in the Bill Payment process

rules.rule_name: Error Flag Activation on Missing Account ID
rules.rule_description: When the Account ID is found to be missing, the system activates an error indicator that prevents all subsequent processing steps in the Bill Payment workflow from executing during the current submission.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Error Flag ON

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has submitted the Bill Payment screen with the ENTER key
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID field is blank or empty
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must activate the error flag (set to 'Y'), which blocks all downstream processing steps — including account lookup, balance check, confirmation processing, and payment execution — from running in the current transaction cycle

rules.rule_name: Account ID Missing Error Message Display
rules.rule_description: When the Account ID is missing, the system communicates the specific validation failure to the user by displaying a descriptive error message and directing the user's attention to the Account ID field for correction.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Error Message: 'Acct ID can NOT be empty...' Highlight Account ID field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account ID field has been determined to be blank or empty upon form submission
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to redisplay the Bill Payment screen due to the missing Account ID
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must display the exact error message 'Acct ID can NOT be empty...' on the screen and position the cursor on the Account ID input field so the user can immediately correct the missing value

rules.rule_name: Bill Payment Screen Redisplay After Account ID Validation Failure
rules.rule_description: After detecting a missing Account ID, the system redisplays the Bill Payment screen with the error message visible, returning control to the user to correct the input and resubmit.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Redisplay Bill Payment Screen with Error Message

acceptance_criteria.Given: The error flag has been activated and the error message 'Acct ID can NOT be empty...' has been set, with the cursor positioned on the Account ID field
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sends the Bill Payment screen back to the user
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Bill Payment screen must be redisplayed with the error message shown, the cursor placed on the Account ID field, and the screen awaiting the user's corrected input — no payment processing, account lookup, or balance retrieval should have occurred

rules.rule_name: Skip Confirmation Processing When Account ID Validation Failed
rules.rule_description: If the Account ID validation has already failed and an error has been flagged, the confirmation field evaluation is bypassed entirely and no further processing occurs for this step.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Account ID Validation Passed?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen and has submitted input
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID validation has failed and an error flag is already set to ON
acceptance_criteria.Then: The confirmation field evaluation is skipped entirely, and the screen with the previously set error message is already displayed to the user — no further processing of the confirmation input occurs

rules.rule_name: Accept Payment Confirmation with 'Y' or 'y'
rules.rule_description: When the user enters 'Y' or 'y' in the Confirmation field, the system marks the payment as confirmed and proceeds to retrieve the account balance from the account data file.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: User entered Y or y → Accept Confirmation, Mark payment as confirmed, Proceed to Account Balance Lookup

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen, has entered a valid Account ID, and no prior errors exist
acceptance_criteria.When: The user enters 'Y' or 'y' (uppercase or lowercase) in the Confirmation field and presses ENTER
acceptance_criteria.Then: The payment is marked as confirmed (CONF-PAY-YES is set to TRUE), and the system proceeds to look up the account record to retrieve the current balance for display and payment processing

rules.rule_name: Cancel Payment When User Enters 'N' or 'n'
rules.rule_description: When the user enters 'N' or 'n' in the Confirmation field, the payment request is cancelled, all input fields on the Bill Payment screen are cleared, and the screen is reset to a blank state.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: User entered N or n → Cancel Payment, Clear all screen fields, Return to blank bill payment screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen, has entered a valid Account ID, and no prior errors exist
acceptance_criteria.When: The user enters 'N' or 'n' (uppercase or lowercase) in the Confirmation field and presses ENTER
acceptance_criteria.Then: The payment is cancelled, all screen fields (Account ID, Current Balance, Confirmation) are cleared and reset to blank, an error flag is set, and the blank Bill Payment screen is redisplayed to the user — no transaction is created and no account is updated

rules.rule_name: Proceed to Account Lookup When Confirmation Field is Blank
rules.rule_description: When the user submits the Bill Payment screen with the Confirmation field left blank, the system treats this as an initial account inquiry — it looks up the account to display the current balance and prompts the user to confirm or cancel the payment.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: User left field blank → No Confirmation Yet, Proceed to Account Balance Lookup without confirming payment

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen, has entered a valid Account ID, and no prior errors exist
acceptance_criteria.When: The user leaves the Confirmation field blank (spaces or empty) and presses ENTER
acceptance_criteria.Then: The payment is NOT marked as confirmed, the system proceeds to look up the account record to retrieve and display the current balance, and the screen is redisplayed with the balance shown and a prompt asking the user to confirm the payment — no transaction is created at this stage

rules.rule_name: Reject Invalid Confirmation Field Value
rules.rule_description: When the user enters any value other than 'Y', 'y', 'N', 'n', or blank in the Confirmation field, the input is rejected with a validation error message and the cursor is repositioned to the Confirmation field for correction.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: User entered any other value → Reject Input, Display Error Message: Invalid value. Valid values are Y or N

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen, has entered a valid Account ID, and no prior errors exist
acceptance_criteria.When: The user enters any value in the Confirmation field that is not 'Y', 'y', 'N', 'n', or blank (e.g., a number, special character, or any other letter) and presses ENTER
acceptance_criteria.Then: An error flag is set to ON, the error message 'Invalid value. Valid values are (Y/N)...' is displayed on the screen, the cursor is repositioned to the Confirmation field to allow the user to correct the entry, and the Bill Payment screen is redisplayed — no account lookup or payment processing occurs

rules.rule_name: Use Entered Account ID as Search Key for Account Lookup
rules.rule_description: The Account ID entered by the user on the Bill Payment screen is used as the unique search key to retrieve the corresponding account record from the Account Data file.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Use entered Account ID as search key

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has entered an Account ID on the Bill Payment screen and the Account ID field is not blank or empty
acceptance_criteria.When: The system initiates an account balance lookup
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system uses the entered Account ID value as the exact search key to query the Account Data file (ACCTDAT) for the matching account record

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Full Account Details Including Current Balance
rules.rule_description: When the Account Data file is successfully queried using the Account ID, the system retrieves the complete account record, which includes the current outstanding balance and all other account details.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve full account details including current balance

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid Account ID on the Bill Payment screen and the account lookup has been initiated
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account Data file (ACCTDAT) is searched using the provided Account ID and a matching account record is found
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the full account record including the current account balance (ACCT-CURR-BAL) and all associated account details into the account record working storage area

rules.rule_name: Account Not Found Error on Bill Payment Screen
rules.rule_description: If the Account ID entered by the user does not match any record in the Account Data file, the system must prevent further processing and notify the user with a specific error message, placing the cursor back on the Account ID field for correction.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display error message: Account ID NOT found

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has entered an Account ID on the Bill Payment screen and the account lookup has been initiated against the Account Data file (ACCTDAT)
acceptance_criteria.When: No matching account record is found in the Account Data file for the provided Account ID
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to active ('Y'), displays the error message 'Account ID NOT found...' on the Bill Payment screen, positions the cursor on the Account ID input field, and redisplays the Bill Payment screen — no further processing such as balance display or payment confirmation occurs

rules.rule_name: Display Current Account Balance on Bill Payment Screen After Successful Lookup
rules.rule_description: After successfully retrieving the account record, the system must display the account's current outstanding balance on the Bill Payment screen so the user can review the amount due before confirming payment.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Move current balance to screen display field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Data file lookup has completed successfully and the full account record including the current balance (ACCT-CURR-BAL) has been retrieved
acceptance_criteria.When: The account record is found and no errors have occurred during the lookup
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system copies the current account balance (ACCT-CURR-BAL) to the current balance display field (CURBALI) on the Bill Payment screen, making the outstanding balance visible to the user

key_functionalities.title: Zero Balance Check
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Account Successfully Retrieved])
    B{Is Account ID\nprovided?}
    C{Is Current Account\nBalance greater\nthan zero?}

rules.rule_name: Zero Balance Check Pre-Condition Gate

rules.rule_name: Account ID Presence Verification Before Balance Check

rules.rule_name: Current Balance Must Be Greater Than Zero to Proceed

rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Current Account Balance greater than zero?

acceptance_criteria.Given: No prior validation errors exist, the Account ID is present, and the account record has been successfully retrieved

rules.rule_name: Zero or Negative Balance Error Message Display

rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Error Message: You have nothing to pay

acceptance_criteria.Given: The account has been retrieved and the Account ID is present on the Bill Payment screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The current account balance is zero or negative
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the error indicator to active, displays the message 'You have nothing to pay...' on the Bill Payment screen, and positions the cursor on the Account ID field

rules.rule_name: Prevent Further Payment Processing on Zero Balance

acceptance_criteria.Given: The current account balance is zero or negative and the Account ID is present

rules.rule_name: Redisplay Bill Payment Screen After Zero Balance Error

acceptance_criteria.Given: The error flag has been set due to a zero or negative account balance

rules.rule_name: Proceed to Payment Confirmation When Balance is Positive
rules.rule_description: When the account balance is confirmed to be greater than zero and no prior errors exist, the system allows the bill payment workflow to advance to the payment confirmation step where the user must explicitly confirm the payment.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Proceed to Payment Confirmation Step

acceptance_criteria.Given: No prior validation errors exist, the Account ID is present on the Bill Payment screen, and the account record has been successfully retrieved

rules.rule_name: Allow Payment Processing When Account Has Outstanding Balance

acceptance_criteria.Then: The system determines that payment confirmation has not been provided, does not process any payment, and proceeds to prompt the user for explicit confirmation before any further action is taken

rules.rule_name: Set Cursor Focus to Confirmation Field When Awaiting Payment Confirmation

rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set cursor focus to Confirmation input field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The account has been successfully retrieved with a positive outstanding balance, and the user has not entered a confirmation value (Confirmation field is blank or empty)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to redisplay the Bill Payment screen to prompt for confirmation
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the cursor focus position to the Confirmation input field, ensuring the user's next input is directed to that field

rules.rule_name: Display Confirmation Prompt Message for Bill Payment
rules.rule_description: When the account lookup is successful and the current balance is positive but the user has not yet confirmed the payment, the system must display a specific instructional message prompting the user to confirm their intent to make a bill payment.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set message: 'Confirm to make a bill payment...'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The account has been successfully retrieved with a positive outstanding balance, and the Confirmation field was blank or empty when the user submitted the screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system is preparing the Bill Payment screen response for the user
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the screen message to 'Confirm to make a bill payment...' to instruct the user to provide their confirmation response

rules.rule_name: Redisplay Bill Payment Screen with Confirmation Prompt and Current Balance
rules.rule_description: After setting the confirmation prompt message and cursor position, the system redisplays the Bill Payment screen showing the current account balance and the confirmation prompt, allowing the user to review the balance and enter Y or N to confirm or cancel the payment.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Bill Payment Screen with confirmation prompt message

acceptance_criteria.Given: The account has been found with a positive outstanding balance, the current balance has been populated on the screen, the message 'Confirm to make a bill payment...' has been set, and the cursor has been directed to the Confirmation input field
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sends the Bill Payment screen back to the user
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Bill Payment screen is displayed showing: (1) the current account balance in the balance display field, (2) the message 'Confirm to make a bill payment...' in the message area, and (3) the cursor positioned on the Confirmation input field, enabling the user to enter Y to proceed with payment or N to cancel

rules.rule_name: Successful Card Number Retrieval from Cross-Reference File
rules.rule_description: When the Card Cross-Reference File lookup completes successfully, the card number associated with the Account ID is retrieved and stored for use in the bill payment transaction record.

acceptance_criteria.Given: A confirmed bill payment request is being processed and the Card Cross-Reference File lookup has been initiated using the Account ID

rules.rule_name: Account ID Not Found in Card Cross-Reference File

rules.rule_name: System Failure During Card Cross-Reference File Lookup

acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must set the error flag to 'Y', display the error message 'Unable to lookup XREF AIX file...' on the Bill Payment screen, position the cursor on the Account ID input field, and return the user to the Bill Payment screen without creating any transaction or updating any account balance

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction ID search key has been set to the highest possible value and the system needs to find the last used Transaction ID

acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction file is successfully opened for browsing, positioned at or near the end of the file, allowing a subsequent backward read to retrieve the last transaction record

rules.rule_name: Read the Last Transaction Record by Browsing Backwards
rules.rule_description: After opening the Transaction file browse session from the highest position, the system reads backwards to retrieve the most recently created transaction record and capture its Transaction ID.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Read the last Transaction record by browsing backwards

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction file browse session is open and positioned at the highest possible Transaction ID
acceptance_criteria.When: The system performs a backward read on the Transaction file

rules.rule_name: Capture Last Used Transaction ID When Record is Found

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has performed a backward read on the Transaction file

rules.rule_name: Handle Empty Transaction File - Set Last Used Transaction ID to Zero

rules.sub_graph_node_text: No existing transactions found - Set last used Transaction ID to zero

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has performed a backward read on the Transaction file
acceptance_criteria.When: The backward read reaches the end of the file without finding any transaction record, indicating the Transaction file is empty

rules.rule_name: Close the Transaction File Browse Session

acceptance_criteria.Given: The backward read of the Transaction file has been completed, either successfully retrieving the last transaction record or determining the file is empty

acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction file browse session is closed and released, making the file available for subsequent write and update operations required to record the new bill payment transaction

rules.rule_name: Generate New Unique Transaction ID by Incrementing Last Used ID

acceptance_criteria.Given: The last used Transaction ID has been determined — either captured from the last existing transaction record in the file, or set to zero if no transactions exist

rules.rule_name: Block Bill Payment on Unexpected Transaction File Access Failure

acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction ID is defaulted to zero, so that when incremented by 1, the first bill payment transaction will be assigned Transaction ID 1

rules.rule_name: Handle Transaction File Read Failure During ID Generation
rules.rule_description: When the backward browse of the Transaction file fails for any reason other than an empty file, the system halts the bill payment process and notifies the user that the transaction lookup was unsuccessful.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Unable to read Transaction record - Display error message to user

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is performing a backward browse of the Transaction file to retrieve the last Transaction ID
acceptance_criteria.When: The backward read operation fails for a reason other than the file being empty
acceptance_criteria.Then: The bill payment process is stopped, an error flag is set, the error message 'Unable to lookup Transaction...' is displayed to the user on the Bill Payment screen, and the cursor is positioned on the Account ID field

rules.rule_name: Generate Next Sequential Transaction ID
rules.rule_description: After the last Transaction ID is determined (either from the last existing record or defaulted to zero for an empty file), the system generates the next Transaction ID by incrementing the last known Transaction ID by exactly 1.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: No transactions exist in file - Default Transaction ID to Zero - Next ID will be generated as 1

acceptance_criteria.Given: The last Transaction ID has been determined — either retrieved from the last existing transaction record or defaulted to zero because the Transaction file is empty
acceptance_criteria.When: The Transaction file browse is ended and the system prepares to create a new bill payment transaction
acceptance_criteria.Then: The new Transaction ID is computed as the last Transaction ID plus 1, ensuring each transaction receives a unique, sequentially incremented identifier

rules.rule_name: End Transaction File Browse After Last Record Retrieval
rules.rule_description: After the backward browse operation to retrieve the last Transaction ID is complete (regardless of outcome), the system must formally close the browse session on the Transaction file before proceeding with any further processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Read the previous Transaction record by browsing backwards from the highest Transaction ID

acceptance_criteria.Given: A backward browse of the Transaction file has been initiated to retrieve the last Transaction ID
acceptance_criteria.When: The backward read operation has completed — whether a record was found, the file was empty, or an error occurred
acceptance_criteria.Then: The browse session on the Transaction file is formally ended, releasing the browse cursor, and the system proceeds to use the retrieved or defaulted Transaction ID for next-ID generation

rules.rule_name: Initialize a Blank Transaction Record Before Population
rules.rule_description: Before populating any bill payment transaction details, a fresh and empty transaction record must be created to ensure no residual or stale data from previous transactions contaminates the new bill payment record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Initialize a blank transaction record

acceptance_criteria.Given: A confirmed bill payment request has been validated and is ready to be recorded
acceptance_criteria.When: The system begins building a new bill payment transaction record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must initialize a completely blank transaction record, clearing all fields to their default empty state before any transaction details are populated

rules.rule_name: Assign Unique Transaction ID to Bill Payment Record
rules.rule_description: Each bill payment transaction must be assigned a unique, sequentially generated transaction identifier. This ID is derived by retrieving the last existing transaction ID and incrementing it by 1, ensuring no two transactions share the same identifier.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Transaction ID to newly generated unique ID

acceptance_criteria.Given: A new sequential transaction ID has been generated by adding 1 to the last existing transaction ID found in the transaction file
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the new bill payment transaction record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must assign the newly generated unique transaction ID to the Transaction ID field of the transaction record

rules.rule_name: Classify Bill Payment with Transaction Type Code '02'
rules.rule_description: All bill payment transactions must be classified using the standard transaction type code '02', which identifies and distinguishes bill payment transactions from other transaction types within the system.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Transaction Type Code to '02'

acceptance_criteria.Given: A new bill payment transaction record is being built
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sets the transaction classification fields
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction Type Code field must be set to the value '02' to designate this transaction as a bill payment type

rules.rule_name: Assign Transaction Category Code 2 to Bill Payment
rules.rule_description: All bill payment transactions must be assigned transaction category code 2, which categorizes the nature of the transaction for reporting, classification, and downstream processing purposes.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Transaction Category Code to 2

acceptance_criteria.Given: A new bill payment transaction record is being built
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sets the transaction category
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction Category Code field must be set to the numeric value 2 to categorize this transaction as a bill payment category

rules.rule_name: Record Transaction Origination Source as POS Terminal
rules.rule_description: All online bill payment transactions must record their origination source as 'POS TERM' (Point of Sale Terminal), indicating the channel through which the payment was initiated for audit and tracking purposes.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Transaction Source to 'POS TERM'

acceptance_criteria.Given: A new bill payment transaction record is being built
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sets the transaction origination source
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction Source field must be set to 'POS TERM' to indicate the payment was initiated through a Point of Sale Terminal channel

rules.rule_name: Set Standard Bill Payment Transaction Description
rules.rule_description: All online bill payment transactions must carry a standardized human-readable description of 'BILL PAYMENT - ONLINE' to clearly identify the nature of the transaction in statements, reports, and transaction histories.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Transaction Description to 'BILL PAYMENT - ONLINE'

acceptance_criteria.Given: A new bill payment transaction record is being built
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sets the transaction description
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction Description field must be set to 'BILL PAYMENT - ONLINE' to provide a clear, standardized description of the bill payment transaction

rules.rule_name: Set Payment Amount Equal to Full Current Account Balance
rules.rule_description: A bill payment always pays the entire outstanding account balance in full. The payment amount recorded on the transaction must equal the full current account balance at the time of payment — partial payments are not supported.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Payment Amount to Full Current Account Balance

acceptance_criteria.Given: A confirmed bill payment is being processed for an account with a current outstanding balance greater than zero
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sets the payment amount on the transaction record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction Amount field must be set to the full current account balance, meaning the entire outstanding balance is paid in one transaction with no option for partial payment

rules.rule_name: Associate Card Number with Bill Payment Transaction
rules.rule_description: Each bill payment transaction must be linked to the card number associated with the account being paid. The card number is retrieved from the Account-to-Card cross-reference record using the Account ID, ensuring the transaction is traceable to the correct card.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Card Number to card associated with the Account

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account-to-Card cross-reference has been successfully looked up using the Account ID, and the associated card number has been retrieved
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sets the card number on the bill payment transaction record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction Card Number field must be set to the card number retrieved from the Account-to-Card cross-reference record, linking the payment to the correct card account

rules.rule_name: Assign Standard Bill Payment Merchant Identification Details
rules.rule_description: All bill payment transactions must be recorded against a standardized internal merchant profile. The merchant is identified with a fixed Merchant ID of 999999999, Merchant Name of 'BILL PAYMENT', and placeholder values of 'N/A' for both Merchant City and Merchant Zip, as bill payments do not involve a physical merchant location.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Merchant ID to 999999999

acceptance_criteria.Given: A new bill payment transaction record is being built
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sets the merchant identification details on the transaction record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Merchant ID field must be set to 999999999, the Merchant Name field must be set to 'BILL PAYMENT', the Merchant City field must be set to 'N/A', and the Merchant Zip field must be set to 'N/A', reflecting that bill payments are not associated with a physical merchant location

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Current Date and Time for Transaction Timestamping
rules.rule_description: Before recording the transaction timestamps, the system must retrieve the current date and time. The timestamp is formatted as a composite value combining the current date in YYYY-MM-DD format and the current time in HH:MM:SS format, with milliseconds set to zero.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve Current Date and Time Timestamp

acceptance_criteria.Given: A bill payment transaction record is being built and requires timestamp information
acceptance_criteria.When: The system retrieves the current date and time for timestamping
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must obtain the current date formatted as YYYY-MM-DD and the current time formatted as HH:MM:SS, combine them into a single timestamp value with milliseconds set to zero, making this timestamp available for assignment to the transaction origination and processing time fields

rules.rule_name: Record Transaction Origination Timestamp
rules.rule_description: Each bill payment transaction must record the exact date and time when the transaction was originated. The origination timestamp captures when the payment request was initiated and is set to the current system date and time at the moment of transaction creation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Transaction Origination Time to Current Timestamp

acceptance_criteria.Given: The current date and time timestamp has been retrieved and formatted
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sets the origination time on the bill payment transaction record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction Origination Timestamp field must be set to the current date and time, recording the exact moment the bill payment transaction was created

rules.rule_name: Record Transaction Processing Timestamp
rules.rule_description: Each bill payment transaction must record the exact date and time when the transaction was processed. For online bill payments, the processing timestamp is set to the same current date and time as the origination timestamp, reflecting that the payment is processed immediately upon submission.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Transaction Processing Time to Current Timestamp

acceptance_criteria.Given: The current date and time timestamp has been retrieved and formatted, and the Transaction Origination Timestamp has already been set
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sets the processing time on the bill payment transaction record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction Processing Timestamp field must be set to the same current date and time value used for the origination timestamp, indicating that online bill payments are originated and processed at the same point in time

acceptance_criteria.Given: The bill payment transaction has been successfully written to the Transaction File and the success message has been composed
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the Bill Payment screen for display following a successful payment
acceptance_criteria.Then: All input fields on the Bill Payment screen are cleared: the Account ID field is set to blank, the Current Balance display field is set to blank, the Confirmation field is set to blank, and the message area is cleared — leaving the screen ready for a fresh bill payment entry, with the cursor positioned on the Account ID field

rules.rule_name: Reject Bill Payment Transaction with Duplicate Transaction ID
rules.rule_description: If the generated Transaction ID already exists in the Transaction File (duplicate key or duplicate record condition), the bill payment must be rejected and the user must be notified that the transaction could not be recorded due to a duplicate Transaction ID.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Error Message: Duplicate Transaction ID detected - Tran ID already exists

acceptance_criteria.Given: A bill payment transaction record has been submitted to the Transaction File with a generated Transaction ID

rules.rule_name: Handle Unexpected Transaction File Write Failure
rules.rule_description: If the Transaction File write operation fails for any reason other than a duplicate Transaction ID, the bill payment must be rejected and the user must be informed that the bill payment transaction could not be added.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Submit new bill payment transaction record to Transaction File

acceptance_criteria.Given: A bill payment transaction record has been submitted to the Transaction File with a generated Transaction ID

acceptance_criteria.Then: The bill payment is rejected, an error flag is set, the error message 'Unable to Add Bill pay Transaction...' is displayed on the Bill Payment screen, the cursor is positioned on the Account ID field, and the user is returned to the Bill Payment screen — no transaction is recorded and no account balance update occurs

rules.rule_name: Compute New Account Balance After Bill Payment
rules.rule_description: After a confirmed bill payment transaction has been successfully recorded, the system calculates the new account balance by subtracting the full payment amount (which equals the entire current balance) from the current account balance, resulting in a zero balance.

acceptance_criteria.When: The system computes the new account balance by subtracting the transaction payment amount (TRAN-AMT) from the current account balance (ACCT-CURR-BAL)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The account's current balance (ACCT-CURR-BAL) is updated to the result of Current Balance minus Payment Amount, which equals zero, reflecting that the full outstanding balance has been paid

rules.rule_name: Write Updated Account Balance to Account Data File

acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the error message 'Account ID NOT found...' on the Bill Payment screen, positions the cursor on the Account ID input field, and redisplays the Bill Payment screen to allow the user to correct the Account ID

rules.rule_name: Account Update Failure Error During Balance Update
rules.rule_description: If the account record update to the Account Data File fails for any reason other than account not found (e.g., file unavailable or system error), the system raises a business error indicating the account could not be updated and prompts the user to re-enter the Account ID.
