acceptance_criteria.Then: The working storage message field (WS-MESSAGE) is set to blank (spaces), removing any previously displayed error or informational messages from the screen

rules.rule_name: Reset Cursor Position to Account ID Field on Screen Reset
rules.rule_description: As part of the screen clear and reset process, the cursor is repositioned to the Account ID input field so the user can immediately begin entering a new account number without manually navigating to the field.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Reset Cursor Position
to Account ID Field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen clear and reset process has been triggered either by PF4 key press or by the user entering 'N'/'n' in the Confirmation field
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the field initialization routine
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor length indicator for the Account ID field (ACTIDINL) is set to -1, which positions the cursor on the Account ID input field when the screen is redisplayed

rules.rule_name: Redisplay Blank Bill Payment Screen with Refreshed Header
rules.rule_description: After all fields and messages have been cleared, the system redisplays the Bill Payment screen in a blank state with an updated header showing current date, time, transaction name, and program name, ready for new user input.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Redisplay Blank
Bill Payment Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: All input fields (Account ID, Current Balance, Confirmation) and all messages have been cleared as part of the screen reset process
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sends the Bill Payment screen back to the user
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Bill Payment screen is redisplayed with all input fields blank, no error or informational messages, and the screen header populated with the current date (MM-DD-YY format), current time (HH:MM:SS format), transaction name, and program name; the cursor is positioned on the Account ID field awaiting new input

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Current System Date and Time for Screen Header
rules.rule_description: Before displaying the Bill Payment screen, the system retrieves the current system date and time to ensure the screen header reflects accurate, real-time information for the user session.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve Current System Date and Time

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Bill Payment screen is about to be displayed to the user
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the screen header information
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the current system date and time using the built-in CURRENT-DATE function and stores it in the working date/time data area (WS-CURDATE-DATA) for subsequent formatting and display

rules.rule_name: Populate Application Title Lines in Screen Header
rules.rule_description: The Bill Payment screen header must display two lines of the application title sourced from the centrally maintained application title definitions (CCDA-TITLE01 and CCDA-TITLE02), ensuring consistent branding across all screens.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Populate Application Title Line 1 and Line 2 in Screen Header

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Bill Payment screen header is being populated
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the application title fields
acceptance_criteria.Then: Application Title Line 1 (CCDA-TITLE01) is placed into the screen header Title Line 1 field (TITLE01O), and Application Title Line 2 (CCDA-TITLE02) is placed into the screen header Title Line 2 field (TITLE02O)

rules.rule_name: Populate Transaction ID in Screen Header
rules.rule_description: The Bill Payment screen header must display the current transaction identifier (WS-TRANID) so the user and support staff can identify the active transaction context during the bill payment session.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Populate Transaction ID in Screen Header

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Bill Payment screen header is being populated
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the transaction identifier field
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current transaction ID (WS-TRANID) is placed into the screen header Transaction Name field (TRNNAMEO)

rules.rule_name: Populate Program Name in Screen Header
rules.rule_description: The Bill Payment screen header must display the name of the currently executing program (WS-PGMNAME) to provide context identification on the screen, supporting navigation awareness and auditability.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Populate Program Name in Screen Header

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Bill Payment screen header is being populated
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the program name field
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current program name (WS-PGMNAME) is placed into the screen header Program Name field (PGMNAMEO)

rules.rule_name: Format and Display Current Date as MM-DD-YY in Screen Header
rules.rule_description: The current date displayed in the Bill Payment screen header must be formatted in MM-DD-YY format. The month, day, and two-digit year are extracted from the retrieved system date and assembled into the standard display format before being placed in the screen header date field.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Format Current Date as MM-DD-YY and populate in Screen Header

acceptance_criteria.Given: The current system date has been retrieved and stored in WS-CURDATE-DATA
acceptance_criteria.When: The system formats the date for screen header display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The month component (WS-CURDATE-MONTH) is moved to WS-CURDATE-MM, the day component (WS-CURDATE-DAY) is moved to WS-CURDATE-DD, the last two digits of the year (WS-CURDATE-YEAR positions 3 and 4) are moved to WS-CURDATE-YY, and the assembled MM-DD-YY formatted date (WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY) is placed into the screen header Current Date field (CURDATEO)

rules.rule_name: Format and Display Current Time as HH:MM:SS in Screen Header
rules.rule_description: The current time displayed in the Bill Payment screen header must be formatted in HH:MM:SS format. The hours, minutes, and seconds are extracted from the retrieved system time and assembled into the standard display format before being placed in the screen header time field.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Format Current Time as HH:MM:SS and populate in Screen Header

acceptance_criteria.Given: The current system time has been retrieved and stored in WS-CURDATE-DATA
acceptance_criteria.When: The system formats the time for screen header display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The hours component (WS-CURTIME-HOURS) is moved to WS-CURTIME-HH, the minutes component (WS-CURTIME-MINUTE) is moved to WS-CURTIME-MM, the seconds component (WS-CURTIME-SECOND) is moved to WS-CURTIME-SS, and the assembled HH:MM:SS formatted time (WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS) is placed into the screen header Current Time field (CURTIMEO)

rules.rule_name: Display Pending Business Message in Screen Message Area
rules.rule_description: Any business message that has been set during processing (such as validation errors, confirmation prompts, or success notifications) must be transferred to the screen's message display area (ERRMSGO) so the user receives relevant feedback when the screen is rendered.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Move any pending message to Screen Message Area

acceptance_criteria.Given: A business message may have been set in WS-MESSAGE during the current processing cycle (e.g., validation error, confirmation prompt, or success notification)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the Bill Payment screen for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The content of WS-MESSAGE is moved to the screen output message field (ERRMSGO of COBIL0AO), making it visible to the user on the rendered screen; if WS-MESSAGE is spaces, the message area on screen will be blank

rules.rule_name: Render and Send Bill Payment Screen to User
rules.rule_description: After all header, data, and message fields have been populated, the fully assembled Bill Payment screen (map COBIL0A from mapset COBIL00) is sent to the user's terminal, erasing any previous screen content and positioning the cursor at the designated input field.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Render Bill Payment Screen with all populated fields, balance, and messages

acceptance_criteria.Given: All screen fields including application titles, transaction ID, program name, current date, current time, account balance, and any business messages have been populated in the screen output area (COBIL0AO)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sends the Bill Payment screen to the user's terminal
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Bill Payment screen (map COBIL0A, mapset COBIL00) is rendered from the populated output data (COBIL0AO), the terminal display is fully erased and replaced with the new screen content, and the cursor is positioned at the designated input field to guide user interaction

rules.rule_name: Default Navigation Destination When No Previous Screen Is Defined
rules.rule_description: When the system initiates a return to a previous screen but no destination program has been set in the communication area, the system defaults the navigation target to the Sign-On Screen (COSGN00C) to ensure the user is always directed to a valid screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Default destination set to Sign-On Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Return to Previous Screen process has been initiated and the destination program field (CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) in the communication area contains spaces or low-values (i.e., no previous screen has been defined)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the destination program field before transferring control
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the destination program to the Sign-On Screen (COSGN00C) as the default navigation target

rules.rule_name: Determine Navigation Destination Based on Originating Program
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF3 to navigate back, the system determines the correct destination by checking whether an originating program is recorded in the communication area. If one exists, the user is returned to that program; otherwise, the user is directed to the main menu.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is a previous screen defined?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF3 on the Bill Payment screen and the system is determining where to navigate back to
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the originating program field (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM) in the communication area
acceptance_criteria.Then: If CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM contains spaces or low-values (no originating program recorded), the destination is set to the main menu screen (COMEN01C); otherwise, the destination is set to the originating program stored in CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM

rules.rule_name: Update Communication Area with Current Program Context Before Navigation
rules.rule_description: Before transferring control to another screen, the system records the current Bill Payment program's identity (program name and transaction ID) into the communication area, and resets the program context indicator to zero. This ensures the receiving screen knows which program initiated the navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Update communication area with current Program Name and Transaction ID

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Return to Previous Screen process has been initiated and the destination program has been determined
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the communication area before transferring control
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system updates the communication area by: (1) copying the current transaction ID (WS-TRANID) into the originating transaction ID field (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID), (2) copying the current program name (WS-PGMNAME) into the originating program field (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM), and (3) setting the program context indicator (CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT) to zeros

rules.rule_name: Transfer Control to Destination Screen with Communication Area
rules.rule_description: After updating the communication area with the current program context, the system transfers control to the determined destination screen, passing the full communication area so the receiving screen has all necessary session and navigation context.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Transfer control to Previous Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The communication area has been updated with the current program name, transaction ID, and context, and the destination program (CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) has been set to either the originating program, the main menu (COMEN01C), or the Sign-On screen (COSGN00C)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the screen transfer
acceptance_criteria.Then: Control is transferred to the destination program identified in CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM, and the full communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) is passed to the receiving program so that session context is preserved across the navigation

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user attempts to access the Bill Payment screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: No active session exists (communication area length is zero)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the destination program to 'COSGN00C' (Sign-On screen) and transfers control to it, preventing access to the Bill Payment screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: New Session Redirect to Sign-On
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Bill Payment program is invoked without an active session, the user must be redirected to the Sign-On screen before any bill payment activity can occur.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An active session exists and the user is visiting the Bill Payment screen for the first time
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program detects it has not been re-entered before (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER is not set)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system marks the screen as re-entered for future visits, clears all display fields to low-values, sets the cursor to the Account ID field, and if a pre-selected transaction value (CDEMO-CB00-TRN-SELECTED) is present (not spaces or low-values), pre-populates the Account ID field with that value and automatically processes it as an Enter key action before displaying the Bill Payment screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: First Entry Screen Initialization
all_rules.Rule_Description: On the first visit to the Bill Payment screen within an active session, the screen is initialized with cleared fields and the cursor is placed on the Account ID field. If an account was pre-selected from a prior screen, the Account ID is pre-populated and account lookup is triggered automatically.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An active session exists and the user has previously visited the Bill Payment screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user submits the Bill Payment screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system receives the screen input data (Account ID field ACTIDINI and Confirmation field CONFIRMI from map COBIL0A/COBIL00) into the input map area for further processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: User Input Reception on Return Visit
all_rules.Rule_Description: On a return visit to the Bill Payment screen, the system receives the user's input data including the Account ID and the payment confirmation indicator from the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen with an active session
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses the PF3 function key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If an originating program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM) is recorded and is not spaces or low-values, the system sets the destination to that originating program; otherwise the destination is set to 'COMEN01C' (main menu), and control is transferred to the destination program passing the current communication area

all_rules.Rule_Name: PF3 Key - Return to Previous Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF3, the system navigates back to the screen from which the user originally came. If no originating screen is recorded, the user is sent to the main menu.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen with an active session
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses the PF4 function key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system clears all input fields (Account ID, Current Balance display, Confirmation indicator) and the message area, then redisplays the blank Bill Payment screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: PF4 Key - Clear Current Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF4, all input and display fields on the Bill Payment screen are cleared, allowing the user to start a new payment entry.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen with an active session
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses any key other than ENTER, PF3, or PF4
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the standard invalid key message (CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY) on the screen, and redisplays the Bill Payment screen without processing any input

all_rules.Rule_Name: Invalid Function Key Handling
all_rules.Rule_Description: Any function key other than ENTER, PF3, or PF4 is not supported on the Bill Payment screen and results in an error message being displayed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen and presses the ENTER key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account ID field (ACTIDINI) is blank or contains only low-values
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the message 'Acct ID can NOT be empty...', sets the cursor position to the Account ID field (ACTIDINL = -1), and redisplays the Bill Payment screen without performing any account lookup or payment processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account ID Mandatory Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Account ID is a required field on the Bill Payment screen. The payment process cannot proceed without a valid Account ID being entered.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid Account ID on the Bill Payment screen and presses ENTER
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Confirmation field (CONFIRMI) contains 'Y' or 'y'
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the payment confirmation flag (CONF-PAY-YES) to TRUE and performs an account data lookup (READ-ACCTDAT-FILE) using the entered Account ID to retrieve the account record for payment processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Payment Confirmation - Confirmed with Y
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user enters 'Y' or 'y' in the Confirmation field, the system sets the payment confirmation flag and proceeds to look up the account details to process the payment.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid Account ID on the Bill Payment screen and presses ENTER
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Confirmation field (CONFIRMI) contains 'N' or 'n'
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system clears all input fields (Account ID, Current Balance display, Confirmation indicator) and the message area, sets the error flag to 'Y', and redisplays the blank Bill Payment screen without performing any payment processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Payment Confirmation - Cancelled with N
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user enters 'N' or 'n' in the Confirmation field, the payment request is cancelled and the screen is cleared.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid Account ID on the Bill Payment screen and presses ENTER
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Confirmation field (CONFIRMI) is blank or contains low-values
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system performs an account data lookup (READ-ACCTDAT-FILE) using the entered Account ID to retrieve and display the current balance, without setting the payment confirmation flag, so the user is subsequently prompted to confirm the payment

all_rules.Rule_Name: Payment Confirmation - Blank Triggers Account Lookup Only
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Confirmation field is left blank, the system performs an account lookup to display the current balance and prompts the user to confirm the payment, implementing the two-step payment process.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid Account ID on the Bill Payment screen and presses ENTER
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Confirmation field (CONFIRMI) contains any value other than 'Y', 'y', 'N', 'n', blank, or low-values
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the message 'Invalid value. Valid values are (Y/N)...', sets the cursor to the Confirmation field (CONFIRML = -1), and redisplays the Bill Payment screen without performing any account lookup or payment processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Payment Confirmation - Invalid Value Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Confirmation field only accepts 'Y', 'y', 'N', 'n', or blank. Any other value is rejected with a validation error.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid Account ID and the Confirmation field is either 'Y', 'y', or blank
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system performs an account lookup using the Account ID (ACCT-ID) as the key against the Account Data file (ACCTDAT) with an update intent
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the account is found, the account record including the current balance (ACCT-CURR-BAL) is retrieved and the current balance is displayed on the screen (CURBALI of COBIL0AI); if the account is not found, the error message 'Account ID NOT found...' is displayed with the cursor on the Account ID field; if any other error occurs, the message 'Unable to lookup Account...' is displayed with the cursor on the Account ID field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account Balance Lookup from Account Data File
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system retrieves the account record from the Account Data file using the entered Account ID to obtain the current outstanding balance for display and payment processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The account has been successfully retrieved from the Account Data file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The account's current balance (ACCT-CURR-BAL) is less than or equal to zero AND the Account ID field is not blank or low-values
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the message 'You have nothing to pay...', sets the cursor to the Account ID field (ACTIDINL = -1), and redisplays the Bill Payment screen without proceeding to payment confirmation or processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Zero or Negative Balance Payment Prevention
all_rules.Rule_Description: A bill payment cannot be initiated if the account has no outstanding balance. Accounts with a zero or negative current balance are blocked from making payments.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The account has been successfully retrieved from the Account Data file and no errors have occurred
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The account record is read successfully with a positive current balance
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system moves the account current balance (ACCT-CURR-BAL) to the working storage balance field (WS-CURR-BAL) and populates the current balance display field (CURBALI of COBIL0AI) on the Bill Payment screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Current Balance Display on Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: After a successful account lookup, the account's current outstanding balance is displayed on the Bill Payment screen so the user can review the amount before confirming payment.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The account has been successfully retrieved, the current balance is greater than zero, and no errors have occurred
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The payment confirmation flag (CONF-PAY-YES) is not set to TRUE (user has not entered 'Y' or 'y' in the Confirmation field)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays the message 'Confirm to make a bill payment...' and sets the cursor to the Confirmation field (CONFIRML = -1), then redisplays the Bill Payment screen awaiting the user's Y or N response

all_rules.Rule_Name: Prompt User to Confirm Payment
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the account has been looked up successfully but the user has not yet confirmed the payment, the system prompts the user to confirm before processing the payment, implementing a two-step payment safety mechanism.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has confirmed the payment with 'Y' or 'y', the account exists, and the current balance is greater than zero
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system performs a lookup on the Card Cross-Reference file (CXACAIX) using the Account ID (XREF-ACCT-ID) as the key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the card cross-reference record is found, the associated card number (XREF-CARD-NUM) is retrieved for use in the transaction record; if the account ID is not found in the cross-reference, the error message 'Account ID NOT found...' is displayed with the cursor on the Account ID field; if any other error occurs, the message 'Unable to lookup XREF AIX file...' is displayed with the cursor on the Account ID field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Cross-Reference Lookup by Account ID
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before processing a confirmed bill payment, the system retrieves the card number associated with the account from the Card Cross-Reference file, which is required to record on the payment transaction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card cross-reference has been successfully retrieved and payment processing is proceeding
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system needs to assign a new Transaction ID for the bill payment
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets TRAN-ID to HIGH-VALUES, starts a browse of the Transaction file (TRANSACT) from the highest possible Transaction ID, reads the previous (last/highest existing) transaction record to obtain its ID (if no transactions exist, TRAN-ID is set to zeros), ends the browse, moves the retrieved TRAN-ID to numeric working storage (WS-TRAN-ID-NUM), and adds 1 to generate the new unique Transaction ID

all_rules.Rule_Name: Sequential Transaction ID Generation
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each bill payment transaction requires a unique Transaction ID. The system generates the next sequential ID by finding the most recently created transaction and incrementing its ID by one.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A new Transaction ID has been generated and payment processing is proceeding
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system builds the bill payment transaction record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system initializes a blank transaction record and populates it with: Transaction ID = newly generated sequential ID, Transaction Type Code = '02', Transaction Category Code = 2, Transaction Source = 'POS TERM', Transaction Description = 'BILL PAYMENT - ONLINE', Transaction Amount = the full current account balance (ACCT-CURR-BAL), Card Number = the card number retrieved from the cross-reference (XREF-CARD-NUM), Merchant ID = 999999999, Merchant Name = 'BILL PAYMENT', Merchant City = 'N/A', Merchant Zip = 'N/A', and both the origination timestamp (TRAN-ORIG-TS) and processing timestamp (TRAN-PROC-TS) are set to the current system date and time

all_rules.Rule_Name: Bill Payment Transaction Record Creation
all_rules.Rule_Description: A complete transaction record is built for the bill payment with all required business attributes including type, category, source, description, full payment amount, card number, merchant details, and timestamps.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The bill payment transaction record has been fully built with all required fields
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system writes the transaction record to the Transaction file (TRANSACT) using the Transaction ID (TRAN-ID) as the record key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the write is successful, the system proceeds to update the account balance; if a duplicate Transaction ID is detected, the error message 'Tran ID already exist...' is displayed with the cursor on the Account ID field and no account update occurs; if any other error occurs, the message 'Unable to Add Bill pay Transaction...' is displayed with the cursor on the Account ID field and no account update occurs

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Record Write to Transaction File
all_rules.Rule_Description: The completed bill payment transaction record is written to the Transaction file to permanently record the payment.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The bill payment transaction record has been successfully written to the Transaction file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system updates the account balance
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system computes the new account balance as: ACCT-CURR-BAL = ACCT-CURR-BAL minus TRAN-AMT (which equals the full prior balance, resulting in zero), then rewrites the updated account record to the Account Data file (ACCTDAT); if the account is not found during update, the message 'Account ID NOT found...' is displayed; if any other error occurs, the message 'Unable to Update Account...' is displayed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account Balance Reduction After Payment
all_rules.Rule_Description: After a successful transaction write, the account's current balance is reduced by the full payment amount (resulting in a zero balance) and the account record is updated in the Account Data file.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The bill payment transaction has been successfully written and the account balance has been updated to zero
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The transaction write operation completes with a normal response
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system clears all input fields (Account ID, Current Balance display, Confirmation indicator, and message area), sets the message color to green (DFHGREEN for ERRMSGC of COBIL0AO), and displays the success message constructed as: 'Payment successful.  Your Transaction ID is [TRAN-ID].' where TRAN-ID is the assigned transaction identifier, then redisplays the Bill Payment screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Payment Success Notification with Transaction ID
all_rules.Rule_Description: Upon successful completion of the bill payment, the user is notified with a green success message that includes the assigned Transaction ID as a payment reference, and all input fields are cleared.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF4 or enters 'N'/'n' in the Confirmation field
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the cursor position indicator for Account ID (ACTIDINL of COBIL0AI) to -1, clears the Account ID input field (ACTIDINI of COBIL0AI) to spaces, clears the Current Balance display field (CURBALI of COBIL0AI) to spaces, clears the Confirmation input field (CONFIRMI of COBIL0AI) to spaces, and clears the working storage message field (WS-MESSAGE) to spaces, then redisplays the Bill Payment screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Screen Clear and Field Reset
all_rules.Rule_Description: All input and display fields on the Bill Payment screen are reset to their initial empty state, used when the user presses PF4 or cancels with 'N'.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system needs to display the Bill Payment screen to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The send screen operation is triggered for any reason (initial display, error, confirmation prompt, or success)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system populates the screen header with: application title line 1 (CCDA-TITLE01 to TITLE01O), application title line 2 (CCDA-TITLE02 to TITLE02O), current transaction name (WS-TRANID to TRNNAMEO), current program name (WS-PGMNAME to PGMNAMEO), current date formatted as MM-DD-YY (to CURDATEO), and current time formatted as HH-MM-SS (to CURTIMEO), then moves the working storage message (WS-MESSAGE) to the screen error message field (ERRMSGO of COBIL0AO) and sends the map COBIL0A from mapset COBIL00 with ERASE and CURSOR options

all_rules.Rule_Name: Bill Payment Screen Display with Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: Every time the Bill Payment screen is rendered, the header information is refreshed with current application titles, program name, transaction name, and the current date and time before the screen is sent to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has triggered a navigation action (PF3 or new session redirect)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the return-to-previous-screen logic
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the destination program (CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) is low-values or spaces, it is defaulted to 'COSGN00C'; the system then sets CDEMO-FROM-TRANID to the current transaction ID (WS-TRANID), sets CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM to the current program name (WS-PGMNAME), sets CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT to zeros, and transfers control via XCTL to the destination program passing the updated CARDDEMO-COMMAREA

all_rules.Rule_Name: Return Control to Calling Program or Main Menu
all_rules.Rule_Description: When navigating away from the Bill Payment screen, control is transferred to the appropriate destination program with the updated communication area containing session context.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user attempts to access the Bill Payment function
Acceptance_Criteria.When: No active user session exists (no communication area data is passed to the program)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system determines that the user is not authenticated and must not be allowed to proceed to the Bill Payment screen; the Sign-On screen is identified as the required destination

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect Missing User Session on Bill Payment Access
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user attempts to access the Bill Payment function, the system must verify that an active user session exists. If no session data is present, the user must be redirected to the Sign-On screen before any bill payment activity is permitted.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has determined that no active user session exists
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The destination screen needs to be set for the unauthenticated user
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the destination program to the Sign-On screen identified as 'COSGN00C'

all_rules.Rule_Name: Identify Sign-On Screen as Destination for Unauthenticated Access
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no active session is detected, the system must designate the Sign-On screen (COSGN00C) as the target destination so that the user can authenticate before accessing the Bill Payment function.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is about to redirect the user to the Sign-On screen due to no active session
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The return navigation details are being prepared
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system records the current transaction identifier (WS-TRANID) as the originating transaction, records the current program name (WS-PGMNAME) as the originating program, and resets the program context indicator to zero to indicate a fresh navigation state

all_rules.Rule_Name: Record Current Program and Transaction Details for Return Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before redirecting an unauthenticated user to the Sign-On screen, the system must record the current Bill Payment program name and transaction identifier so that navigation context is preserved for potential return routing after sign-on.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: No active user session exists and the Sign-On screen has been identified as the destination, and current program and transaction details have been recorded
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the redirect
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Control is transferred to the Sign-On screen program ('COSGN00C') along with the current communication area data, and the Bill Payment program terminates its current execution

all_rules.Rule_Name: Redirect Unauthenticated User to Sign-On Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: After recording navigation details, the system must transfer control to the Sign-On screen, passing the session communication area, so the user can authenticate. This enforces that only authenticated users can access the Bill Payment function.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user attempts to access the Bill Payment function
Acceptance_Criteria.When: An active user session exists (communication area data is present and its length is greater than zero)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system loads the full session communication area data into the active working session context (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) and proceeds to display the Bill Payment screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Load Existing Session Data for Authenticated User
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an active user session is detected, the system must load the existing session data from the communication area into the working session context so that user identity, navigation history, and prior screen state are available for the Bill Payment function.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user navigates to the Bill Payment screen for the first time within the current session, meaning the program re-entry flag (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER) has not yet been set
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program detects that this is the initial entry by evaluating that CDEMO-PGM-REENTER is NOT set to TRUE
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All screen output display fields (COBIL0AO) are cleared by setting them to LOW-VALUES, ensuring no residual data from a previous session or screen is visible to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect First Entry and Initialize Bill Payment Screen Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: On the very first entry into the Bill Payment screen, the system must initialize all screen output fields to ensure no stale or residual data is shown to the user before any account information is loaded.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has confirmed this is the first entry into the Bill Payment screen (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER is NOT TRUE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The first-entry initialization process begins
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program re-entry flag (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER) is set to TRUE so that all future interactions with this screen within the same session are treated as return visits and do not re-initialize the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark Bill Payment Session as Re-Entry to Prevent Re-Initialization
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the first entry is detected and initialization begins, the session must be flagged as re-entering so that subsequent interactions with the same screen do not trigger re-initialization of the display fields.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Bill Payment screen is being initialized for first-time display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen initialization process sets up the input fields
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor length indicator for the Account ID field (ACTIDINL of COBIL0AI) is set to -1, which positions the cursor on the Account ID input field when the screen is rendered

all_rules.Rule_Name: Position Cursor on Account ID Field at Screen Entry
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Bill Payment screen is first displayed, the cursor must be automatically positioned on the Account ID input field to guide the user to enter the required account information without manual navigation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Bill Payment screen is being initialized for the first time
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the pre-selected transaction value (CDEMO-CB00-TRN-SELECTED) passed through the communication area from the previous screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If CDEMO-CB00-TRN-SELECTED contains a value that is neither SPACES nor LOW-VALUES, the system determines that an Account ID has been passed from the previous screen and proceeds to pre-populate it; otherwise, the screen is displayed with an empty Account ID field awaiting manual user input

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect Whether an Account ID Was Passed from a Previous Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: During first entry setup, the system must determine whether a prior screen has already provided an Account ID for bill payment processing. This allows seamless navigation where account context is carried forward automatically.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Bill Payment screen is being initialized for the first time AND the pre-selected transaction value (CDEMO-CB00-TRN-SELECTED) from the previous screen is not empty (not SPACES and not LOW-VALUES)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system detects a valid Account ID has been passed from the previous screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account ID input field on the Bill Payment screen (ACTIDINI of COBIL0AI) is populated with the value from CDEMO-CB00-TRN-SELECTED, so the user sees the account already filled in

all_rules.Rule_Name: Pre-Populate Account ID Field with Value Passed from Previous Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an Account ID has been passed from a previous screen, the Bill Payment screen must automatically populate the Account ID input field with that value, eliminating the need for the user to re-enter information already known to the system.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Bill Payment screen is being initialized for the first time AND the Account ID field has been pre-populated with a value passed from the previous screen (CDEMO-CB00-TRN-SELECTED is not SPACES and not LOW-VALUES)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The pre-population of the Account ID field is complete
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The PROCESS-ENTER-KEY routine is invoked automatically to validate the Account ID, look up the account record, retrieve the current balance, and apply all associated business validations (empty account ID check, balance check, confirmation field evaluation) as if the user had pressed the Enter key

all_rules.Rule_Name: Automatically Process Pre-Populated Account ID to Retrieve Account Details
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an Account ID is pre-populated from a previous screen, the system must automatically trigger the account lookup and validation process — as if the user had manually entered the Account ID and pressed Enter — so that the current balance is retrieved and displayed without requiring an additional user action.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Bill Payment screen has completed its first-entry initialization, including clearing display fields, optionally pre-populating the Account ID, and optionally processing the pre-populated account
Acceptance_Criteria.When: All initialization steps have been executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN routine is invoked, which: (1) populates the screen header with the current date (MM-DD-YY format), current time (HH:MM:SS format), transaction name, and program name; (2) moves any pending message to the error message field (ERRMSGO of COBIL0AO); and (3) sends the COBIL0A map from the COBIL00 mapset to the user's terminal with ERASE and CURSOR options, making the screen ready for user input

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Bill Payment Screen with Initialized or Pre-Populated Data
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all first-entry initialization steps are complete — whether or not an Account ID was pre-populated — the Bill Payment screen must be sent to the user with the current header information (date, time, program name, transaction name) and any data that has been set up during initialization.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has previously visited the Bill Payment screen (the session is marked as re-entering) and has submitted the screen with input data
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system receives the submitted Bill Payment screen data from map 'COBIL0A' within mapset 'COBIL00' into the Bill Payment input data area (COBIL0AI)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All user-entered data from the Bill Payment screen is captured into the input data structure (COBIL0AI), making it available for downstream processing including key press evaluation and business validations

all_rules.Rule_Name: Capture Bill Payment Screen Input Data
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user submits the Bill Payment screen on a return visit, the system must receive and capture all data entered by the user from the Bill Payment screen map (COBIL0A) into the input data structure for subsequent processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a value (or left blank) in the Account ID field on the Bill Payment screen and submitted the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system captures the Bill Payment screen input data
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account ID value entered by the user is stored in the Account ID input field (ACTIDINI of COBIL0AI) and is available for validation and account lookup processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Capture Account ID Input Field
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Account ID entered by the user on the Bill Payment screen is captured as part of the screen receive operation. This value (ACTIDINI) represents the account for which the user wishes to make a bill payment and is the primary identifier used in all subsequent account lookup and payment processing steps.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a value (Y, N, or left blank) in the Payment Confirmation field on the Bill Payment screen and submitted the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system captures the Bill Payment screen input data
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Payment Confirmation Indicator value entered by the user is stored in the Confirmation input field (CONFIRMI of COBIL0AI) and is available for payment confirmation decision processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Capture Payment Confirmation Indicator Input Field
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Payment Confirmation Indicator entered by the user on the Bill Payment screen is captured as part of the screen receive operation. This value (CONFIRMI) represents the user's intent to confirm or cancel the bill payment and drives the two-step payment confirmation workflow.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has an active session and is interacting with the Bill Payment screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program determines whether this is the user's first visit or a return visit to the Bill Payment screen by checking the re-entry flag (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If it is a return visit (re-entry flag is TRUE), the system proceeds to receive and capture screen input data; if it is the first visit (re-entry flag is FALSE), the system skips input reception, marks the session as re-entering for future visits, and directly displays the Bill Payment screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Screen Input Reception Restricted to Return Visits Only
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system only attempts to receive and capture user input from the Bill Payment screen when the user is returning to the screen (re-entry mode). On the very first visit to the screen, no input reception occurs — the screen is simply displayed to the user. This ensures that input capture only happens when there is actual user-submitted data to process.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen and a prior originating program name is recorded in the session communication area (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is not blank and not empty)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses the PF3 (Go Back) function key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the destination program to the recorded originating program name (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM), records the current program name and transaction ID as the 'from' context, resets the program context to zero, and transfers control to the originating screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: PF3 Navigation - Return to Previous Screen When Prior Screen Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF3 on the Bill Payment screen and a prior originating screen is recorded in the session, the system navigates the user back to that originating screen, passing along the current session context.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen and no prior originating program is recorded in the session communication area (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is blank or empty)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses the PF3 (Go Back) function key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the destination program to the main menu program 'COMEN01C', records the current program name and transaction ID as the 'from' context, resets the program context to zero, and transfers control to the main menu screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: PF3 Navigation - Return to Main Menu When No Prior Screen Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF3 on the Bill Payment screen and no prior originating screen is recorded in the session, the system redirects the user to the main menu screen (COMEN01C) as the default fallback destination.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen with any data entered or displayed in the Account ID, Current Balance, Confirmation, or Message fields
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses the PF4 (Clear Screen) function key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system clears the Account ID field to spaces, clears the Current Balance field to spaces, clears the Confirmation field to spaces, clears the message area to spaces, sets the cursor position to the Account ID field, and redisplays the Bill Payment screen in a blank state

all_rules.Rule_Name: PF4 Navigation - Clear All Bill Payment Screen Fields
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF4 on the Bill Payment screen, all input and display fields are cleared and the screen is redisplayed in a blank state, allowing the user to start a new bill payment entry.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses any key that is not ENTER, PF3, or PF4
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', populates the message area with the standard invalid key message (CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY), and redisplays the Bill Payment screen with the error message shown, without processing any data

all_rules.Rule_Name: Invalid Function Key - Display Error Message
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses any function key other than ENTER, PF3, or PF4 on the Bill Payment screen, the system rejects the action and displays a standard invalid key error message, keeping the user on the same screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF3 and a destination program has been determined (either the prior originating screen or the main menu COMEN01C)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the return-to-previous-screen navigation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system records the current Bill Payment transaction ID into the session 'from transaction ID' field (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID), records the current Bill Payment program name into the session 'from program' field (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM), resets the program context indicator to zero (CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT), and transfers control to the destination program passing the full session communication area

all_rules.Rule_Name: PF3 Navigation - Transfer Session Context to Destination Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When navigating away from the Bill Payment screen via PF3, the system ensures the session communication area carries the correct originating program identity and transaction ID so the destination screen knows where the user came from.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen and has pressed the ENTER key to submit the form
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account ID field is blank or contains only empty/null values
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must reject the submission, set the error indicator to active, display the error message 'Acct ID can NOT be empty...', position the cursor on the Account ID field, and redisplay the Bill Payment screen with the error message — preventing any further processing steps from executing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account ID Mandatory Field Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Bill Payment process requires a valid Account ID before any processing can occur. The system must validate that the Account ID field contains a value when the user submits the Bill Payment screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen and has pressed the ENTER key to submit the form
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account ID field contains a non-blank, non-empty value
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must not set any error flag or display any error message related to Account ID, and must proceed to the next validation step in the Bill Payment process

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account ID Presence Check Allows Proceeding
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account ID field contains a value, the Bill Payment process is permitted to advance to the next validation step without triggering any error condition.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted the Bill Payment screen with the ENTER key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account ID field is blank or empty
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must activate the error flag (set to 'Y'), which blocks all downstream processing steps — including account lookup, balance check, confirmation processing, and payment execution — from running in the current transaction cycle

all_rules.Rule_Name: Error Flag Activation on Missing Account ID
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account ID is found to be missing, the system activates an error indicator that prevents all subsequent processing steps in the Bill Payment workflow from executing during the current submission.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account ID field has been determined to be blank or empty upon form submission
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to redisplay the Bill Payment screen due to the missing Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must display the exact error message 'Acct ID can NOT be empty...' on the screen and position the cursor on the Account ID input field so the user can immediately correct the missing value

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account ID Missing Error Message Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account ID is missing, the system communicates the specific validation failure to the user by displaying a descriptive error message and directing the user's attention to the Account ID field for correction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The error flag has been activated and the error message 'Acct ID can NOT be empty...' has been set, with the cursor positioned on the Account ID field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sends the Bill Payment screen back to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Bill Payment screen must be redisplayed with the error message shown, the cursor placed on the Account ID field, and the screen awaiting the user's corrected input — no payment processing, account lookup, or balance retrieval should have occurred

all_rules.Rule_Name: Bill Payment Screen Redisplay After Account ID Validation Failure
all_rules.Rule_Description: After detecting a missing Account ID, the system redisplays the Bill Payment screen with the error message visible, returning control to the user to correct the input and resubmit.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen and has submitted input
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account ID validation has failed and an error flag is already set to ON
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The confirmation field evaluation is skipped entirely, and the screen with the previously set error message is already displayed to the user — no further processing of the confirmation input occurs

all_rules.Rule_Name: Skip Confirmation Processing When Account ID Validation Failed
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the Account ID validation has already failed and an error has been flagged, the confirmation field evaluation is bypassed entirely and no further processing occurs for this step.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen, has entered a valid Account ID, and no prior errors exist
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user enters 'Y' or 'y' (uppercase or lowercase) in the Confirmation field and presses ENTER
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The payment is marked as confirmed (CONF-PAY-YES is set to TRUE), and the system proceeds to look up the account record to retrieve the current balance for display and payment processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Accept Payment Confirmation with 'Y' or 'y'
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user enters 'Y' or 'y' in the Confirmation field, the system marks the payment as confirmed and proceeds to retrieve the account balance from the account data file.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen, has entered a valid Account ID, and no prior errors exist
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user enters 'N' or 'n' (uppercase or lowercase) in the Confirmation field and presses ENTER
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The payment is cancelled, all screen fields (Account ID, Current Balance, Confirmation) are cleared and reset to blank, an error flag is set, and the blank Bill Payment screen is redisplayed to the user — no transaction is created and no account is updated

all_rules.Rule_Name: Cancel Payment When User Enters 'N' or 'n'
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user enters 'N' or 'n' in the Confirmation field, the payment request is cancelled, all input fields on the Bill Payment screen are cleared, and the screen is reset to a blank state.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen, has entered a valid Account ID, and no prior errors exist
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user leaves the Confirmation field blank (spaces or empty) and presses ENTER
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The payment is NOT marked as confirmed, the system proceeds to look up the account record to retrieve and display the current balance, and the screen is redisplayed with the balance shown and a prompt asking the user to confirm the payment — no transaction is created at this stage

all_rules.Rule_Name: Proceed to Account Lookup When Confirmation Field is Blank
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user submits the Bill Payment screen with the Confirmation field left blank, the system treats this as an initial account inquiry — it looks up the account to display the current balance and prompts the user to confirm or cancel the payment.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Bill Payment screen, has entered a valid Account ID, and no prior errors exist
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user enters any value in the Confirmation field that is not 'Y', 'y', 'N', 'n', or blank (e.g., a number, special character, or any other letter) and presses ENTER
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: An error flag is set to ON, the error message 'Invalid value. Valid values are (Y/N)...' is displayed on the screen, the cursor is repositioned to the Confirmation field to allow the user to correct the entry, and the Bill Payment screen is redisplayed — no account lookup or payment processing occurs

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reject Invalid Confirmation Field Value
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user enters any value other than 'Y', 'y', 'N', 'n', or blank in the Confirmation field, the input is rejected with a validation error message and the cursor is repositioned to the Confirmation field for correction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has entered an Account ID on the Bill Payment screen and the Account ID field is not blank or empty
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system initiates an account balance lookup
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system uses the entered Account ID value as the exact search key to query the Account Data file (ACCTDAT) for the matching account record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Use Entered Account ID as Search Key for Account Lookup
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Account ID entered by the user on the Bill Payment screen is used as the unique search key to retrieve the corresponding account record from the Account Data file.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid Account ID on the Bill Payment screen and the account lookup has been initiated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account Data file (ACCTDAT) is searched using the provided Account ID and a matching account record is found
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the full account record including the current account balance (ACCT-CURR-BAL) and all associated account details into the account record working storage area

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Full Account Details Including Current Balance
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account Data file is successfully queried using the Account ID, the system retrieves the complete account record, which includes the current outstanding balance and all other account details.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has entered an Account ID on the Bill Payment screen and the account lookup has been initiated against the Account Data file (ACCTDAT)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: No matching account record is found in the Account Data file for the provided Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to active ('Y'), displays the error message 'Account ID NOT found...' on the Bill Payment screen, positions the cursor on the Account ID input field, and redisplays the Bill Payment screen — no further processing such as balance display or payment confirmation occurs

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account Not Found Error on Bill Payment Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the Account ID entered by the user does not match any record in the Account Data file, the system must prevent further processing and notify the user with a specific error message, placing the cursor back on the Account ID field for correction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Data file lookup has completed successfully and the full account record including the current balance (ACCT-CURR-BAL) has been retrieved
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The account record is found and no errors have occurred during the lookup
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system copies the current account balance (ACCT-CURR-BAL) to the current balance display field (CURBALI) on the Bill Payment screen, making the outstanding balance visible to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Current Account Balance on Bill Payment Screen After Successful Lookup
all_rules.Rule_Description: After successfully retrieving the account record, the system must display the account's current outstanding balance on the Bill Payment screen so the user can review the amount due before confirming payment.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has submitted the Bill Payment screen with an Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A prior validation error has already been raised during the current processing of the Enter key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The zero balance check is skipped entirely and no further payment processing steps are attempted

all_rules.Rule_Name: Zero Balance Check Pre-Condition Gate
all_rules.Rule_Description: The zero balance check is only performed when no prior validation errors have occurred during the current bill payment processing cycle. If a prior error already exists, the balance check is bypassed entirely.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: No prior validation errors exist and an account record has been retrieved
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account ID field on the Bill Payment screen is blank or contains only low values
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The zero balance check condition is not triggered and the Bill Payment screen is redisplayed without a zero-balance error

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account ID Presence Verification Before Balance Check
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before performing the zero balance check, the system verifies that the Account ID field contains a meaningful value. The balance check is only triggered when the Account ID is present and non-blank, ensuring the check is applied to a valid account context.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: No prior validation errors exist, the Account ID is present, and the account record has been successfully retrieved
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The current account balance is zero or a negative amount
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system determines that the account has no outstanding balance and the payment cannot proceed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Current Balance Must Be Greater Than Zero to Proceed
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system enforces that a bill payment can only be initiated when the account has an outstanding positive balance. If the current account balance is zero or negative, the payment process is blocked because there is nothing owed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The account has been retrieved and the Account ID is present on the Bill Payment screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The current account balance is zero or negative
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error indicator to active, displays the message 'You have nothing to pay...' on the Bill Payment screen, and positions the cursor on the Account ID field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Zero or Negative Balance Error Message Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an account's current balance is zero or negative, the system informs the user that there is no outstanding amount to pay by displaying a specific error message on the Bill Payment screen, with the cursor positioned on the Account ID field to prompt correction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The current account balance is zero or negative and the Account ID is present
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The zero balance validation check fails
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The error flag is set to active ('Y'), which blocks all downstream payment processing steps including payment confirmation check, transaction record creation, and account balance update from executing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Prevent Further Payment Processing on Zero Balance
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a zero or negative balance is detected, the system activates the error flag to prevent any subsequent payment processing steps — such as payment confirmation, transaction creation, or account balance update — from being executed in the current cycle.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The error flag has been set due to a zero or negative account balance
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Bill Payment screen is sent to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Bill Payment screen is displayed with the error message 'You have nothing to pay...', the screen header is populated with the current date, current time, transaction name, and program name, and the cursor is positioned on the Account ID field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Redisplay Bill Payment Screen After Zero Balance Error
all_rules.Rule_Description: After detecting a zero or negative balance, the system redisplays the Bill Payment screen with the error message visible, the current date and time refreshed in the header, and the cursor placed on the Account ID field, allowing the user to take corrective action.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: No prior validation errors exist, the Account ID is present on the Bill Payment screen, and the account record has been successfully retrieved
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The current account balance is greater than zero
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system proceeds to evaluate the payment confirmation field to determine whether the user has confirmed or is yet to confirm the bill payment

all_rules.Rule_Name: Proceed to Payment Confirmation When Balance is Positive
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the account balance is confirmed to be greater than zero and no prior errors exist, the system allows the bill payment workflow to advance to the payment confirmation step where the user must explicitly confirm the payment.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An account record has been successfully retrieved from the Account Data File using the entered Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system processes the retrieved account record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current account balance (ACCT-CURR-BAL) is moved to the working storage balance field (WS-CURR-BAL), and then transferred to the Current Balance display field (CURBALI) on the Bill Payment screen so the user can see the outstanding amount due

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve and Display Current Account Balance for User Review
all_rules.Rule_Description: After successfully retrieving the account record, the system extracts the current outstanding balance and populates it on the Bill Payment screen so the user can review the amount due before deciding to confirm or cancel the payment.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The account record has been successfully retrieved and the current balance has been displayed on the Bill Payment screen, AND the Account ID field is not empty or blank
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the current account balance (ACCT-CURR-BAL) and finds it is less than or equal to zero
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the message 'You have nothing to pay...' on the Bill Payment screen, positions the cursor on the Account ID field, redisplays the Bill Payment screen, and halts all further payment processing for this transaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Block Bill Payment When Account Balance is Zero or Negative
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system prevents a bill payment from being initiated when the account's current balance is zero or negative, as there is no outstanding amount to pay. An informational message is displayed and no further payment processing occurs.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The account record has been successfully retrieved and the current balance has been populated on the Bill Payment screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the current account balance (ACCT-CURR-BAL) and finds it is greater than zero
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: No error is raised, the current balance remains displayed on the screen in the CURBALI field, and the payment workflow continues to the next step where the user can review the amount due and enter a confirmation (Y/N) to proceed with or cancel the bill payment

all_rules.Rule_Name: Allow Payment Processing When Account Has Outstanding Balance
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the account has a positive outstanding balance, the system allows the bill payment workflow to continue, enabling the user to review the displayed balance and proceed to confirm or cancel the payment.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid Account ID on the Bill Payment screen, the account exists in the system with a positive outstanding balance, and the Confirmation field is left blank or empty (no value entered)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses the ENTER key to submit the Bill Payment screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system determines that payment confirmation has not been provided, does not process any payment, and proceeds to prompt the user for explicit confirmation before any further action is taken

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect Missing Payment Confirmation on Initial Account Lookup
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user submits the Bill Payment screen with a valid Account ID but leaves the Confirmation field blank or empty, the system recognizes that the user has not yet confirmed the payment intent and must be prompted before any payment is processed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The account has been successfully retrieved with a positive outstanding balance, and the user has not entered a confirmation value (Confirmation field is blank or empty)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to redisplay the Bill Payment screen to prompt for confirmation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the cursor focus position to the Confirmation input field, ensuring the user's next input is directed to that field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Cursor Focus to Confirmation Field When Awaiting Payment Confirmation
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the system determines that the user has not yet confirmed the bill payment (Confirmation field is blank), the cursor must be directed to the Confirmation input field so the user can immediately enter their Y or N response without navigating manually.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The account has been successfully retrieved with a positive outstanding balance, and the Confirmation field was blank or empty when the user submitted the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system is preparing the Bill Payment screen response for the user
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the screen message to 'Confirm to make a bill payment...' to instruct the user to provide their confirmation response

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Confirmation Prompt Message for Bill Payment
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the account lookup is successful and the current balance is positive but the user has not yet confirmed the payment, the system must display a specific instructional message prompting the user to confirm their intent to make a bill payment.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The account has been found with a positive outstanding balance, the current balance has been populated on the screen, the message 'Confirm to make a bill payment...' has been set, and the cursor has been directed to the Confirmation input field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sends the Bill Payment screen back to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Bill Payment screen is displayed showing: (1) the current account balance in the balance display field, (2) the message 'Confirm to make a bill payment...' in the message area, and (3) the cursor positioned on the Confirmation input field, enabling the user to enter Y to proceed with payment or N to cancel

all_rules.Rule_Name: Redisplay Bill Payment Screen with Confirmation Prompt and Current Balance
all_rules.Rule_Description: After setting the confirmation prompt message and cursor position, the system redisplays the Bill Payment screen showing the current account balance and the confirmation prompt, allowing the user to review the balance and enter Y or N to confirm or cancel the payment.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has entered a valid Account ID on the Bill Payment screen, the account has a positive outstanding balance, and the user has entered 'Y' or 'y' in the Confirmation field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses the ENTER key to submit the confirmed payment request
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must use the confirmed Account ID to search the Card Cross-Reference File (CXACAIX) to retrieve the card number linked to that account, before proceeding to generate a Transaction ID or create any transaction record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Trigger Card Cross-Reference Lookup Upon Payment Confirmation
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user confirms a bill payment by entering 'Y' in the confirmation field, the system must initiate a lookup of the Card Cross-Reference File using the Account ID to retrieve the associated card number before any transaction can be created.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A confirmed bill payment request is being processed and the Card Cross-Reference File lookup has been initiated using the Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Cross-Reference File returns a successful response for the given Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The card number (XREF-CARD-NUM) associated with the Account ID is successfully retrieved and made available to be recorded on the bill payment transaction record, and the process continues to Transaction ID generation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Successful Card Number Retrieval from Cross-Reference File
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Card Cross-Reference File lookup completes successfully, the card number associated with the Account ID is retrieved and stored for use in the bill payment transaction record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A confirmed bill payment request is being processed and the Card Cross-Reference File lookup has been initiated using the Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Cross-Reference File lookup returns a 'not found' response, meaning no card record is associated with the provided Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must set the error flag to 'Y', display the error message 'Account ID NOT found...' on the Bill Payment screen, position the cursor on the Account ID input field, and return the user to the Bill Payment screen without creating any transaction or updating any account balance

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account ID Not Found in Card Cross-Reference File
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account ID entered by the user does not exist in the Card Cross-Reference File, the system must halt the payment process and notify the user with a specific error message.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A confirmed bill payment request is being processed and the Card Cross-Reference File lookup has been initiated using the Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Cross-Reference File lookup returns an unexpected failure response that is neither a successful retrieval nor a 'not found' condition
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must set the error flag to 'Y', display the error message 'Unable to lookup XREF AIX file...' on the Bill Payment screen, position the cursor on the Account ID input field, and return the user to the Bill Payment screen without creating any transaction or updating any account balance

all_rules.Rule_Name: System Failure During Card Cross-Reference File Lookup
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an unexpected system or file access issue occurs during the Card Cross-Reference File lookup, the system must halt the payment process and notify the user with an appropriate error message.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The bill payment process requires generating a new unique Transaction ID and is about to search the Transaction file for the last used ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to browse the Transaction file backwards
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the Transaction ID search key to the highest possible value (HIGH-VALUES) so that the backward browse will position at the very end of the Transaction file and retrieve the last existing transaction record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Starting Position to Highest Possible Transaction ID for Backward Search
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before browsing the transaction file to find the last used Transaction ID, the search anchor must be set to the maximum possible value so that the backward read retrieves the most recently created transaction record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction ID search key has been set to the highest possible value and the system needs to find the last used Transaction ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system initiates a browse session on the Transaction file using the highest possible Transaction ID as the starting position
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction file is successfully opened for browsing, positioned at or near the end of the file, allowing a subsequent backward read to retrieve the last transaction record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Open Transaction File for Backward Browsing
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Transaction file must be opened in browse mode starting from the highest Transaction ID position before any backward read can be performed to find the last used Transaction ID.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction file browse session is open and positioned at the highest possible Transaction ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system performs a backward read on the Transaction file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the last transaction record in the file, capturing the Transaction ID from that record for use in generating the next sequential Transaction ID

all_rules.Rule_Name: Read the Last Transaction Record by Browsing Backwards
all_rules.Rule_Description: After opening the Transaction file browse session from the highest position, the system reads backwards to retrieve the most recently created transaction record and capture its Transaction ID.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has performed a backward read on the Transaction file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A transaction record is successfully found and returned by the backward read
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction ID value from the retrieved record is captured and retained as the last used Transaction ID, to be used as the basis for generating the next sequential Transaction ID

all_rules.Rule_Name: Capture Last Used Transaction ID When Record is Found
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the backward browse successfully retrieves an existing transaction record, the Transaction ID from that record is retained as the last used Transaction ID, which will be incremented to generate the next unique Transaction ID.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has performed a backward read on the Transaction file
